# ============================================================
# SKETCHUP RUBY - BANG VINH DANH DONG VANG, DE GO DO
# Don vi: mm | SketchUp 2021+
# Cach dung: Window > Ruby Console > load file .rb
# ============================================================

module BangVinhDanh3D
  extend self

  def mat(name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    m = Sketchup.active_model.materials[name] ||
        Sketchup.active_model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    m.alpha = alpha
    m
  end

  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    pts = [
      [x-sx/2, y-sy/2, z-sz/2],
      [x+sx/2, y-sy/2, z-sz/2],
      [x+sx/2, y+sy/2, z-sz/2],
      [x-sx/2, y+sy/2, z-sz/2]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    f = e.add_face(pts)
    return g unless f

    f.reverse! if f.normal.z < 0
    f.pushpull(sz)

    # Pushpull theo Z, sau do chinh tam khoi ve cao do z
    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation([0, 0, z-sz/2])
    )
    g.material = material
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = material
      face.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  # Tao khoi hop bang 8 diem, dung truc X/Y/Z
  def solid_box(entities, name, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    x1, x2 = x-sx/2, x+sx/2
    y1, y2 = y-sy/2, y+sy/2
    z1, z2 = z-sz/2, z+sz/2

    faces = [
      [[x1,y1,z1],[x2,y1,z1],[x2,y2,z1],[x1,y2,z1]],
      [[x1,y1,z2],[x1,y2,z2],[x2,y2,z2],[x2,y1,z2]],
      [[x1,y1,z1],[x1,y1,z2],[x2,y1,z2],[x2,y1,z1]],
      [[x1,y2,z1],[x2,y2,z1],[x2,y2,z2],[x1,y2,z2]],
      [[x1,y1,z1],[x1,y2,z1],[x1,y2,z2],[x1,y1,z2]],
      [[x2,y1,z1],[x2,y1,z2],[x2,y2,z2],[x2,y2,z1]]
    ]

    faces.each do |arr|
      face = e.add_face(arr.map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) })
      next unless face
      face.reverse! if face.normal.dot(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          face.bounds.center.x-x,
          face.bounds.center.y-y,
          face.bounds.center.z-z
        )
      ) < 0
      face.material = material
      face.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  # Chu noi 3D: mat chu huong ra phia truoc bang (Y am)
  def text3d(entities, string, x, front_y, z,
             height, material, bold = true, extrusion = 1.2)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "Chu noi - #{string}"

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        string,
        TextAlignCenter = 1,
        "Arial",
        bold,
        false,
        height,
        0.5,
        0,
        true,
        extrusion
      )
    rescue
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        string, 1, "Arial", bold, false, height, 0.5, 0
      )
    end

    # Mat phang XY cua text xoay thanh mat phang XZ
    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees
    )
    translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      [x, front_y, z]
    )
    g.transform!(translation * rotation)

    g.material = material
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      f.material = material
      f.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  def border_frame(entities, x, y, z, w, h, t, material, name)
    
  def border_frame(entities, x, y, z, w, h, t, material, name)
    solid_box(entities, "#{name} - Tren", x, y, z+h/2-t/2, w, t, t, material)
    solid_box(entities, "#{name} - Duoi", x, y, z-h/2+t/2, w, t, t, material)
    solid_box(entities, "#{name} - Trai", x-w/2+t/2, y, z, t, t, h-2*t, material)
    solid_box(entities, "#{name} - Phai", x+w/2-t/2, y, z, t, t, h-2*t, material)
  end
end
BangVinhDanh3D.border_frame(Sketchup.active_model.entities, 0, 0, 0, 300, 150, 10, BangVinhDanh3D.mat("go", [120, 60, 20]), "Khung") rescue nil

# ============================================================
# BANG TEN GIAM DOC - NHAT KHOA HUNG
# SketchUp Ruby API | Don vi: mm
# Tao bang ten 3D, de go, khung, mat vang, chu noi, logo, hoa tiet
# Luu file: bang_ten_nhat_khoa_hung.rb
# ============================================================

module NhatKhoaHungPlaque
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "BANG_TEN_NHAT_KHOA_HUNG"

  # Kich thuoc tong the (mm) - co the thay doi
  W       = 600.mm
  H_PANEL = 245.mm
  D_PANEL = 18.mm
  BASE_W  = 650.mm
  BASE_D  = 165.mm
  BASE_H  = 22.mm

  def mat(model, name, color, texture_size = nil)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    m
  end

  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    pts = [
      [x,      y,      z],
      [x + dx, y,      z],
      [x + dx, y + dy, z],
      [x,      y + dy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    f = e.add_face(pts)
    if f
      f.reverse! if f.normal.z < 0
      f.pushpull(dz)
      e.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
        face.material = material
        face.back_material = material
      end
    end
    g
  end

  # Tao thanh hop co tiet dien vuong
  def beam(entities, name, p1, p2, width, depth, material)
    a = Geom::Point3d.new(*p1)
    b = Geom::Point3d.new(*p2)
    v = b - a
    return if v.length < 0.001

    # Dung thanh theo truc X hoac Z, phu hop khung mat dung
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    length = v.length
    if v.parallel?(Geom::Vector3d.new(1, 0, 0))
      box(g.entities, name + "_solid",
          [a.x, b.x].min, a.y, a.z - width / 2,
          length, depth, width, material)
    elsif v.parallel?(Geom::Vector3d.new(0, 0, 1))
      box(g.entities, name + "_solid",
          a.x - width / 2, a.y, [a.z, b.z].min,
          width, depth, length, material)
    end
    g
  end

  # Chu noi 3D tren mat dung.
  # Mat truoc cua bang huong ve phia Y am.
  def front_text(entities, name, string, x, z, height,
                 material, bold = true, font = "Arial",
                 extrusion = 0.8.mm)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    ok = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      string,
      TextAlignCenter,
      font,
      bold,
      false,
      height,
      0.1.mm,
      0,
      true,
      extrusion
    )

    unless ok
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Chu tao tren mat XY; xoay 90 do de dung tren mat XZ.
    # Sau xoay, truc Z cua chu huong ra phia truoc.
    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees
    )
    translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      Geom::Vector3d.new(x, -0.5.mm, z)
    )
    g.transform!(translation * rotation)

    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = material
      face.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  # Duong tron trang tri nam tren mat dung XZ.
  def circle_front(entities, name, cx, cz, radius, material,
                   segments = 32, thickness = 0.5.mm)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    center = Geom::Point3d.new(cx, -0.4.mm, cz)
    normal = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, -1, 0)

    edges = g.entities.add_circle(center, normal, radius, segments)
    face = g.entities.add_face(edges)
    if face
      face.material = material
      face.pushpull(thickness)
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = material
        f.back_material = material
      end
    end
    g
  end

  # Mot canh hoa cach dieu, lap thanh dai trang tri.
  def ornament(entities, x, z, scale, gold, index)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "Hoa_tiet_vien_#{index}"

    # Hai cung tron nho va mot tam giac kim loai cach dieu
    center = Geom::Point3d.new(x, -0.6.mm, z)
    normal = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, -1, 0)

    [-1, 1].each do |side|
      c = Geom::Point3d.new(
        x + side * 2.0.mm * scale, -0.6.mm, z
      )
      edges = g.entities.add_circle(
        c, normal, 2.2.mm * scale, 12
      )
      edges.each { |edge| edge.soft = true if edge.valid? }
    end

    # Duong trang tri dang chu S don gian
    pts = [
      Geom::Point3d.new(x - 4.mm * scale, -0.6.mm, z),
      Geom::Point3d.new(x - 1.mm * scale, -0.6.mm, z + 2.mm * scale),
      Geom::Point3d.new(x + 1.mm * scale, -0.6.mm, z - 2.mm * scale),
      Geom::Point3d.new(x + 4.mm * scale, -0.6.mm, z)
    ]
    g.entities.add_curve(pts)

    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Edge).each do |edge|
      edge.material = gold
    end
    g
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation("Dung bang ten Nhat Khoa Hung", true)

    # Vat lieu
    wood       = mat(model, "Go_do_ruou",       [92, 15, 25])
    wood_light = mat(model, "Go_do_sang",       [130, 28, 38])
    gold       = mat(model, "Vang_kim_loai",    [224, 184, 42])
    gold_light = mat(model, "Vang_sang",        [255, 222, 92])
    gold_dark  = mat(model, "Vang_vien_dam",    [126, 92, 19])
    blue       = mat(model, "Xanh_logo_chu",    [15, 37, 135])
    green      = mat(model, "Xanh_la_logo",     [25, 120, 63])
    red        = mat(model, "Do_chu_KIM_NHO",   [198, 15, 18])
    white      = mat(model, "Trang_vien_chu",   [255, 241, 190])
    black      = mat(model, "Den_nau",          [53, 28, 12])

    # Xoa group cu neu chay lai
    old = model.entities.grep(Sketchup::Group).find do |g|
      g.name == MODEL_NAME
    end
    old.erase! if old && old.valid?

    root = model.entities.add_group
    root.name = MODEL_NAME
    e = root.entities

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. DE GO NHIEU CAP
    # Mat truoc la Y am, chieu cao Z duong
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    box(e, "De_go_cap_duoi",
        -BASE_W / 2, 0, 0,
        BASE_W, BASE_D, BASE_H, wood)

    box(e, "De_go_cap_tren",
        -310.mm, 12.mm, BASE_H,
        620.mm, 135.mm, 28.mm, wood_light)

    # Thanh vien vang tren de
    box(e, "Nep_vang_trang_tri_de",
        -300.mm, 8.mm, 47.mm,
        600.mm, 5.mm, 12.mm, gold)

    box(e, "Nep_vang_sang",
        -300.mm, 7.mm, 58.mm,
        600.mm, 4.mm, 1.8.mm, gold_light)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. KHUNG BANG DUNG
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    panel_z = 72.mm
    panel_y = 38.mm
    panel_w = W
    panel_h = H_PANEL
    panel_front_y = panel_y

    # Than bang va mat vang
    box(e, "Than_khung_go",
        -panel_w / 2, panel_y, panel_z,
        panel_w, D_PANEL, panel_h, wood)

    box(e, "Mat_bang_vang",
        -panel_w / 2 + 8.mm,
        panel_y - 0.5.mm,
        panel_z + 8.mm,
        panel_w - 16.mm,
        1.2.mm,
        panel_h - 16.mm,
        gold)

    # Vien vang ngoai
    frame = 5.mm
    y_frame = panel_y - 1.2.mm
    z0 = panel_z + 5.mm
    inner_w = panel_w - 10.mm
    inner_h = panel_h - 10.mm

    box(e, "Vien_vang_duoi",
        -inner_w / 2, y_frame, z0,
        inner_w, 2.mm, frame, gold_light)

    box(e, "Vien_vang_tren",
        -inner_w / 2, y_frame, z0 + inner_h - frame,
        inner_w, 2.mm, frame, gold_light)

    box(e, "Vien_vang_trai",
        -inner_w / 2, y_frame, z0,
        frame, 2.mm, inner_h, gold_light)

    box(e, "Vien_vang_phai",
        inner_w / 2 - frame, y_frame, z0,
        frame, 2.mm, inner_h, gold_light)

    # Vien trong mau vang dam
    box(e, "Vien_trong_duoi",
        -275.mm, panel_y - 1.8.mm, panel_z + 29.mm,
        550.mm, 1.5.mm, 1.5.mm, gold_dark)

    box(e, "Vien_trong_tren",
        -275.mm, panel_y - 1.8.mm, panel_z + 214.mm,
        550.mm, 1.5.mm, 1.5.mm, gold_dark)

    box(e, "Vien_trong_trai",
        -275.mm, panel_y - 1.8.mm, panel_z + 29.mm,
        1.5.mm, 1.5.mm, 185.mm, gold_dark)

    box(e, "Vien_trong_phai",
        273.5.mm, panel_y - 1.8.mm, panel_z + 29.mm,
        1.5.mm, 1.5.mm, 185.mm, gold_dark)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. HOA TIET LAP LAI QUANH VIEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Dai tren va duoi
    (0..54).each do |i|
      x = -265.mm + i * 9.8.mm
      ornament(e, x, panel_z + 20.mm, 0.7, gold_light, i)
      ornament(e, x, panel_z + 222.mm, 0.7, gold_light, i + 100)
    end

    # Hai dai doc
    (0..18).each do |i|
      z = panel_z + 32.mm + i * 9.8.mm
      ornament(e, -285.mm, z, 0.7, gold_light, i + 200)
      ornament(e,  285.mm, z, 0.7, gold_light, i + 300)
    end

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. CHU NOI 3D
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Logo va ten don vi
    front_text(e, "Ten_cong_ty",
      "NHAT KHOA HUNG",
      65.mm, panel_z + 177.mm, 27.mm,
      blue, true, "Arial", 0.8.mm)

    front_text(e, "Chi_nhanh",
      "CHI NHANH VINH LONG",
      65.mm, panel_z + 149.mm, 17.mm,
      blue, true, "Arial", 0.6.mm)

    front_text(e, "Chuc_danh",
      "GIAM DOC",
      0.mm, panel_z + 103.mm, 19.mm,
      blue, true, "Times New Roman", 0.8.mm)

    front_text(e, "Ten_giam_doc",
      "KIM NHO",
      0.mm, panel_z + 42.mm, 47.mm,
      red, true, "Arial", 1.2.mm)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. LOGO HOA CACH DIEU
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    logo_x = -225.mm
    logo_z = panel_z + 171.mm
    circle_front(e, "Logo_vong_ngoai",
      logo_x, logo_z, 23.mm, green, 48, 0.5.mm)

    circle_front(e, "Logo_vong_trong",
      logo_x, logo_z, 17.mm, gold, 48, 0.4.mm)

    # 5 canh hoa tao bang cac duong tron giao nhau
    petal_radius = 9.mm
    5.times do |i|
      angle = i * 72.degrees - 90.degrees
      px = logo_x + Math.cos(angle) * 10.mm
      pz = logo_z + Math.sin(angle) * 10.mm

      circle_front(e, "Logo_canh_hoa_#{i + 1}",
        px, pz, petal_radius, blue, 32, 0.7.mm)
    end

    circle_front(e, "Logo_nhu hoa",
      logo_x, logo_z, 3.mm, gold_light, 24, 0.8.mm)

    front_text(e, "Logo_ten",
      "NHAT KHOA HUNG",
      logo_x, panel_z + 143.mm, 6.mm,
      blue, true, "Times New Roman", 0.3.mm)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. DUONG PHAN CACH TRANG TRI
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    box(e, "Duong_ngang_trang_tri",
        -110.mm, panel_y - 1.mm, panel_z + 130.mm,
        220.mm, 0.8.mm, 0.8.mm, gold_light)

    # Cac nut tron trang tri tren duong ngang
    [-45, -30, -15, 0, 15, 30, 45].each_with_index do |offset, i|
      circle_front(e, "Nut_trang_tri_#{i}",
        offset.mm, panel_z + 130.mm,
        1.8.mm, gold_light, 16, 0.4.mm)
    end

# ============================================================
# THUY NaBi - TIEM THUE DO BMT
# SKETCHUP RUBY API - MO HINH BIEN QUANG CAO 3D
# Don vi: mm
#
# Bao gom:
# 1. Tam nen alu/PVC trang
# 2. Khung vien nhom
# 3. Chu THUY NaBi noi 3D
# 4. Dong chu phu va duong gach ngang
# 5. Khu vuc thong tin lien he
# 6. Icon dia diem, dien thoai, Facebook
#
# Luu file: thuy_nabi_sign.rb
# ============================================================

module ThuyNabiSign
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "THUY_NABI_BIEN_QUANG_CAO"

  # Kich thuoc uoc tinh theo anh
  SIGN_W = 2400.mm
  SIGN_H = 1500.mm
  PANEL_T = 25.mm

  FRAME_W = 18.mm
  FRAME_D = 30.mm

  # Do noi chu
  MAIN_TEXT_D = 18.mm
  SUB_TEXT_D = 4.mm

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def material(model, name, rgb)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def paint(group, mat)
    group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      f.material = mat
      f.back_material = mat
    end
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    points = [
      [x, y, z],
      [x + dx, y, z],
      [x + dx, y + dy, z],
      [x, y + dy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    face = g.entities.add_face(points)

    if face
      face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
      face.pushpull(dz)
      paint(g, mat)
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # TAM CHU NHAT DUNG
  # Mat truoc huong Y am
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def panel(entities, name, x, z, width, height,
            thickness, mat)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    # Mat sau cua tam
    box(g.entities, "Tam_vat_lieu",
        x, 0, z,
        width, thickness, height, mat)

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D
  # Tao text trong mat XY, xoay de dung tren mat XZ
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def text3d(entities, name, string, cx, cz,
             face_y, text_height, font, bold,
             mat, extrusion)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    ok = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      string,
      TextAlignCenter,
      font,
      bold,
      false,
      text_height,
      0.0,
      0,
      true,
      extrusion
    )

    unless ok
      g.erase!
      puts "Khong tao duoc chu: #{string}"
      return nil
    end

    # Xoay mat chu XY thanh XZ
    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees
    )
    g.transform!(rotation)

    # Can giua bounding box sau khi xoay
    bb = g.bounds
    bx = (bb.min.x + bb.max.x) / 2.0
    bz = (bb.min.z + bb.max.z) / 2.0
    by = bb.min.y

    translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      Geom::Vector3d.new(cx - bx, face_y - by, cz - bz)
    )
    g.transform!(translation)

    paint(g, mat)
    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # VIEN KHUNG BANG
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def make_frame(entities, w, h, frame_w, y, depth, mat)
    # Canh tren
    box(entities, "Khung_tren",
        -w / 2, y, h - frame_w,
        w, depth, frame_w, mat)

    # Canh duoi
    box(entities, "Khung_duoi",
        -w / 2, y, 0,
        w, depth, frame_w, mat)

    # Canh trai
    box(entities, "Khung_trai",
        -w / 2, y, 0,
        frame_w, depth, h, mat)

    # Canh phai
    box(entities, "Khung_phai",
        w / 2 - frame_w, y, 0,
        frame_w, depth, h, mat)
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # DUONG TRANG TRI NGANG
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def horizontal_line(entities, name, x1, x2, z, y, thickness, mat)
    box(entities, name,
        x1, y, z - thickness / 2,
        x2 - x1, 2.mm, thickness, mat)
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # ICON TRON VA CHAM TRON
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  def circle_icon(entities, name, cx, cz, radius, y, depth, mat, segments = 24)
    box(entities, name, cx - radius, y, cz - radius, radius * 2, depth, radius * 2, mat)
  end
end

module ADMAKE_Lightbox
  extend self

  # ---------- VAT LIEU ----------
  def mat(model, name, rgb)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  # ---------- HOP CHU NHAT ----------
  def box(ents, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, material)
    g = ents.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    pts = [
      [x, y, z], [x + dx, y, z],
      [x + dx, y + dy, z], [x, y + dy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    f = e.add_face(pts)
    if f
      f.reverse! if f.normal.z < 0
      f.pushpull(dz)
      e.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
        face.material = material
        face.back_material = material
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------- HOP DEN BO GOC ----------
  # Mat truoc nam tren mat phang XZ, truc chieu sau la Y.
  def rounded_panel(ents, name, cx, cy, cz,
                    width, height, depth, radius,
                    face_mat, side_mat)

    g = ents.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    hw = width / 2.0
    hh = height / 2.0
    r = [[radius, hw - 1.mm, hh - 1.mm].min, 1.mm].max
    seg = 12

    # Tao duong bao bo goc trong mat phang XZ
    corners = [
      [cx + hw - r, cz + hh - r, 0],
      [cx - hw + r, cz + hh - r, 90],
      [cx - hw + r, cz - hh + r, 180],
      [cx + hw - r, cz - hh + r, 270]
    ]

    # Goc phan tu duoc tao theo thu tu quanh chu vi
    points = []
    [
      [cx + hw - r, cz + hh - r, 0, 90],
      [cx - hw + r, cz + hh - r, 90, 180],
      [cx - hw + r, cz - hh + r, 180, 270],
      [cx + hw - r, cz - hh + r, 270, 360]
    ].each do |ox, oz, a0, a1|
      (0..seg).each do |i|
        a = (a0 + (a1 - a0) * i.to_f / seg) * Math::PI / 180
        points << Geom::Point3d.new(
          ox + r * Math.cos(a),
          cy,
          oz + r * Math.sin(a)
        )
      end
    end

    face = e.add_face(points)
    return g unless face

    # Huong extrude ve phia sau
    face.reverse! if face.normal.y > 0
    face.pushpull(depth)

    # Gan vat lieu mat truoc va mat ben
    e.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      center_y = f.bounds.center.y
      if (center_y - cy).abs < 0.01
        f.material = face_mat
        f.back_material = face_mat
      else
        f.material = side_mat
        f.back_material = side_mat
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------- THANH THEP HOP ----------
  def steel_bar(ents, name, p1, p2, size, material)
    a = Geom::Point3d.new(*p1)
    b = Geom::Point3d.new(*p2)
    v = b - a
    return if v.length < 0.1

    axis = v.normalize
    ref = axis.parallel?(Z_AXIS) ? X_AXIS : Z_AXIS
    u = axis.cross(ref).normalize
    w = axis.cross(u).normalize

    s = size / 2.0

    pts = [
      a.offset(u, -s).offset(w, -s),
      a.offset(u,  s).offset(w, -s),
      a.offset(u,  s).offset(w,  s),
      a.offset(u, -s).offset(w,  s)
    ]

    g = ents.add_group
    g.name = name
    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)

    if f
      f.reverse! if f.normal.dot(axis) < 0
      f.pushpull(v.length)
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
        face.material = material
        face.back_material = material
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------- VIEN NHOM BAO QUANH MAT DEN ----------
  def aluminum_frame(ents, name, cx, cy, cz,
                     width, height, radius, tube_size, material)

    g = ents.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    hw = width / 2.0
    hh = height / 2.0
    r = radius
    n = 16
    pts = []

    [
      [cx + hw - r, cz + hh - r, 0, 90],
      [cx - hw + r, cz + hh - r, 90, 180],
      [cx - hw + r, cz - hh + r, 180, 270],
      [cx + hw - r, cz - hh + r, 270, 360]
    ].each do |ox, oz, a0, a1|
      (0..n).each do |i|
        a = (a0 + (a1-a0)*i.to_f/n) * Math::PI / 180
        pts << Geom::Point3d.new(
          ox + r*Math.cos(a), cy,
          oz + r*Math.sin(a)
        )
      end
    end

    # Ve duong vien tren mat truoc
    pts.each_with_index do |p, i|
      e.add_line(p, pts[(i+1) % pts.length])
    end

    # Tao vien day bang cac doan thanh nho
    pts.each_with_index do |p, i|
      q = pts[(i+1) % pts.length]
      v = q - p
      next if v.length < 0.1

      # Thanh profile vuong nho, bo tri theo chu vi
      axis = v.normalize
      ref = Z_AXIS
      ref = X_AXIS if axis.parallel?(ref)
      u = axis.cross(ref).normalize
      w = axis.cross(u).normalize
      s = tube_size / 2.0

      corners = [
        p.offset(u,-s).offset(w,-s),
        p.offset(u, s).offset(w,-s),
        p.offset(u, s).offset(w, s),
        p.offset(u,-s).offset(w, s)
      ]

      bar = e.add_group
      f = bar.entities.add_face(corners)
      if f
        f.reverse! if f.normal.dot(axis) < 0
        f.pushpull(v.length)
        bar.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |ff|
          ff.material = material
          ff.back_material = material
        end
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------- CHAY DUNG MO HINH ----------
  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ADMAKE - Cum hop den mica', true)

    white = mat(model, 'Mica trang sua', [246, 247, 245])
    silver = mat(model, 'Nhom anod bac', [175, 181, 184])
    steel = mat(model, 'Thep hop xam', [85, 91, 94])
    dark = mat(model, 'Than hop den', [55, 59, 61])

    root = model.active_entities.add_group
    root.name = 'CUM HOP DEN MICA - ADMAKE'
    e = root.entities

    # ===== THONG SO CO THE DIEU CHINH =====
    panel_w = 800.mm
    panel_h = 800.mm
    panel_depth = 100.mm
    corner_r = 100.mm
    frame_t = 18.mm

    panel_count = 5
    spacing = 150.mm

    stand_w = 500.mm
    stand_d = 700.mm
    stand_h = 850.mm
    foot_h = 40.mm
    steel_size = 40.mm

    # ===== CHAN DE =====
    z0 = 0

    # Khung de chu nhat
    steel_bar(e, 'De truoc trai',
      [-stand_w/2, -stand_d/2, z0],
      [-stand_w/2, stand_d/2, z0], steel_size, steel)

    steel_bar(e, 'De truoc phai',
      [stand_w/2, -stand_d/2, z0],
      [stand_w/2, stand_d/2, z0], steel_size, steel)

    steel_bar(e, 'De ngang truoc',
      [-stand_w/2, -stand_d/2, z0],
      [stand_w/2, -stand_d/2, z0], steel_size, steel)

    steel_bar(e, 'De ngang sau',
      [-stand_w/2, stand_d/2, z0],
      [stand_w/2, stand_d/2, z0], steel_size, steel)

    # Ban de sat
    box(e, 'Ban de sat',
      -stand_w/2, -stand_d/2, -foot_h,
      stand_w, stand_d, foot_h, silver)

    # Hai tru dung
    support_z = stand_h
    [-stand_w/4, stand_w/4].each_with_index do |x, i|
      steel_bar(e, "Tru dung #{i+1}",
        [x, 0, 0],
        [x, 0, support_z], steel_size, steel)
    end

    # Thanh ngang giua hai tru
    steel_bar(e, 'Thanh ngang tren',
      [-stand_w/4, 0, support_z],
      [stand_w/4, 0, support_z], steel_size, steel)

    # Thanh giang cheo
    steel_bar(e, 'Giang cheo trai',
      [-stand_w/4, 0, 180.mm],
      [0, 0, 450.mm], 25.mm, steel)

    steel_bar(e, 'Giang cheo phai',
      [0, 0, 450.mm],
      [stand_w/4, 0, 180.mm], 25.mm, steel)

    # ===== CAC HOP DEN XEP LOP =====
    panel_bottom = support_z + 100.mm
    panel_center_z = panel_bottom + panel_h/2.0

    panel_count.times do |i|
      # Mat truoc huong ve Y am
      cy = i * spacing

      panel = rounded_panel(
        e, "Hop den mica #{i+1}",
        0, cy, panel_center_z,
        panel_w, panel_h, panel_depth,
        corner_r, white, dark
      )

      # Vien nhom phia truoc
      aluminum_frame(
        e, "Vien nhom hop #{i+1}",
        0, cy - 2.mm, panel_center_z,
        panel_w + 10.mm, panel_h + 10.mm,
        corner_r + 5.mm, frame_t, silver
      )
    end

    model.commit_operation
    model.active_view.zoom_extents
    UI.messagebox(
      "Da tao cum hop den 3D.\n" \
      "So luong: #{panel_count}\n" \
      "Kich thuoc mat: #{panel_w.to_mm.round} x " \
      "#{panel_h.to_mm.round} mm\n" \
      "Chieu day: #{panel_depth.to_mm.round} mm"
    )
  rescue => err
    model.abort_operation
    UI.messagebox("Loi Ruby: #{err.message}\n#{err.backtrace.first}")
  end
end

# ============================================================
# HAFELE - DANG TUAN
# SKETCHUP RUBY API | 3D SIGN + BIM
# Don vi: mm
#
# Tam bang:
#   - Phan tren: do hong
#   - Phan duoi: trang
#   - Chu HAFELE noi 3D
#   - Chu DANG TUAN noi 3D
#   - Thong tin phu
#   - Khung vien va khung thep sau
#
# Cach dung:
# 1. Luu thanh dang_tuan_hafele.rb
# 2. Mo SketchUp > Window > Ruby Console
# 3. Chay: load "D:/SketchUp/dang_tuan_hafele.rb"
#
# Luu y:
# Kich thuoc va bo tri la gia tri uoc tinh theo anh.
# ============================================================

module DangTuanHafele
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "DANG_TUAN_HAFELE_3D"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # CAU HINH KICH THUOC (mm)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  W = 6000.mm
  H = 3000.mm

  PANEL_D = 45.mm
  FRAME_D = 40.mm
  FRAME_W = 45.mm

  RED_H = 1750.mm
  WHITE_H = H - RED_H

  MAIN_TEXT_DEPTH = 35.mm
  SUB_TEXT_DEPTH  = 8.mm

  # Khoang lui cua chu so voi mat bang
  LETTER_OFFSET = 3.mm

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def material(model, name, rgb)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def paint(entities, mat)
    entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      f.material = mat
      f.back_material = mat
    end
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP: X, Y, Z
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    pts = [
      [x, y, z],
      [x + dx, y, z],
      [x + dx, y + dy, z],
      [x, y + dy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    face = g.entities.add_face(pts)

    if face
      face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
      face.pushpull(dz)
      paint(g.entities, mat)
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D
  # Mat truoc huong ve Y am
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def text3d(entities, name, string, cx, cz,
             front_y, height, font, bold, mat, depth)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    ok = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      string,
      TextAlignCenter,
      font,
      bold,
      false,
      height,
      0.0,
      0,
      true,
      depth
    )

    unless ok
      puts "Khong tao duoc chu: #{string}"
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Xoay mat chu tu XY sang XZ
    rot = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees
    )
    g.transform!(rot)

    # Can giua theo X va Z
    bb = g.bounds
    mid_x = (bb.min.x + bb.max.x) / 2.0
    mid_z = (bb.min.z + bb.max.z) / 2.0

    # Sau khi xoay, mat chu gan Y=0 va extrusion huong -Y
    target_y = front_y - LETTER_OFFSET
    dy = target_y - bb.min.y

    move = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      Geom::Vector3d.new(cx - mid_x, dy, cz - mid_z)
    )
    g.transform!(move)

    paint(g.entities, mat)
    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # TAO TAM NEN DUNG
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def vertical_panel(entities, name, x, z, w, h, depth, mat)
    box(
      entities, name,
      x, -depth, z,
      w, depth, h, mat
    )
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG VIEN MAT TRUOC
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def make_front_frame(entities, w, h, t, depth, mat)
    y = -PANEL_D - depth

    # Canh tren
    box(entities, "Vien_tren",
        -w / 2, y, h - t,
        w, depth, t, mat)

    # Canh duoi
    box(entities, "Vien_duoi",
        -w / 2, y, 0,
        w, depth, t, mat)

    # Canh trai
    box(entities, "Vien_trai",
        -w / 2, y, 0,
        t, depth, h, mat)

    # Canh phai
    box(entities, "Vien_phai",
        w / 2 - t, y, 0,
        t, depth, h, mat)
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # TAO THANH NGANG
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def rail(entities, name, x, y, z, length, depth, height, mat)
    box(entities, name, x, y, z, length, depth, height, mat)
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # DUNG MO HINH
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation("Dung bang HAFELE DANG TUAN", true)

    begin
      # Vat lieu
      red = material(model, "Son_do_hong",
                     [177, 54, 83])

      white = material(model, "Alu_trang",
                       [242, 242, 239])

      black = material(model, "Chu_den",
                       [24, 20, 24])

      
      hafele_white = material(model, "Chu_HAFELE_trang", [244, 244, 244])
      panel(entities, "Mat_bang", 0, 0, 0, 4500, 1600, 20, white)
      text3d(entities, "HAFELE", 500, 50, "Arial", hafele_white, 200, 30, 800)
    rescue => e
    ensure
      model.commit_operation
    end
  end
end

module Lop66Sign
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "LOP66_SIGN_3D"

  # ---------------- THONG SO ----------------
  W = 6000.mm
  H = 1200.mm
  PANEL_T = 25.mm
  FRAME_T = 30.mm
  FRAME_D = 35.mm

  INFO_H = 190.mm
  TITLE_H = 410.mm
  TITLE_D = 22.mm
  SMALL_D = 5.mm

  # ---------------- VAT LIEU ----------------
  def mat(model, name, rgb)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def paint(group, material)
    group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      f.material = material
      f.back_material = material
    end
  end

  # ---------------- KHOI HOP ----------------
  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    pts = [
      [x, y, z],
      [x + dx, y, z],
      [x + dx, y + dy, z],
      [x, y + dy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    face = g.entities.add_face(pts)

    if face
      face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
      face.pushpull(dz)
      paint(g, material)
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------------- CHU NOI 3D ----------------
  # Text duoc tao tren XY, sau do xoay thanh mat XZ.
  # Mat truoc huong Y am.
  def text3d(entities, name, string, cx, cz, front_y,
             height, font, bold, material, depth)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    success = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      string,
      TextAlignCenter,
      font,
      bold,
      false,
      height,
      0.0,
      0,
      true,
      depth
    )

    unless success
      puts "Khong tao duoc text: #{string}"
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Xoay chu dung tren mat bang
    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees
    )
    g.transform!(rotation)

    bb = g.bounds
    center_x = (bb.min.x + bb.max.x) / 2.0
    center_z = (bb.min.z + bb.max.z) / 2.0

    # Can mat chu ve phia truoc bang
    delta_y = front_y - bb.min.y

    translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      Geom::Vector3d.new(
        cx - center_x,
        delta_y,
        cz - center_z
      )
    )
    g.transform!(translation)

    paint(g, material)
    g
  end

  # ---------------- DUONG THANH ----------------
  def rail(entities, name, x1, z1, x2, z2,
           width, y, depth, material)

    dx = x2 - x1
    dz = z2 - z1
    length = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
    return nil if length < 0.1.mm

    angle = Math.atan2(dz, dx)
    g = box(
      entities, name,
      x1, y, z1 - width / 2.0,
      length, depth, width, material
    )

    # Xoay thanh quanh diem dau
    tr = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      Geom::Point3d.new(x1, y, z1),
      Y_AXIS,
      -angle
    )

    g.transform!(tr)
    g
  end

  # ---------------- VONG TRON TREN MAT XZ ----------------
  def ring_lines(entities, name, cx, cz, radius, y, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    center = Geom::Point3d.new(cx, y, cz)
    normal = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, -1, 0)

    g.entities.add_circle(center, normal, radius, 48)

    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Edge).each do |edge|
      edge.material = material
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------------- ICON LOP XE ----------------
  def tire_icon(entities, cx, cz, radius, y, black, grey, orange)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "04_Banh_xe_3D"

    # Cac duong tron mo phong lop va mam
    ring_lines(g.entities, "Lop_ngoai",
               cx, cz, radius, y, grey)

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Thanh_lop",
               cx, cz, radius * 0.88, y - 1.mm, black)

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Vien_mam",
               cx, cz, radius * 0.58, y - 2.mm, grey)

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Tam_mam",
               cx, cz, radius * 0.45, y - 3.mm, orange)

    # Gai lop dang thanh ngan theo chu vi
    24.times do |i|
      angle = 2.0 * Math::PI * i / 24.0
      r1 = radius * 0.91
      r2 = radius * 0.99

      x1 = cx + r1 * Math.cos(angle)
      z1 = cz + r1 * Math.sin(angle)
      x2 = cx + r2 * Math.cos(angle + 0.06)
      z2 = cz + r2 * Math.sin(angle + 0.06)

      rail(
        g.entities, "Gai_lop_#{i + 1}",
        x1, z1, x2, z2,
        5.mm, y - 2.mm, 2.mm, black
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------------- ICON MAM XE ----------------
  def wheel_icon(entities, cx, cz, radius, y, grey, white)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "06_Icon_mam_xe"

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Mam_vien",
               cx, cz, radius, y, grey)

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Mam_trong",
               cx, cz, radius * 0.76, y - 1.mm, white)

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Bau_mam",
               cx, cz, radius * 0.24, y - 2.mm, grey)

    # 8 nan mam
    8.times do |i|
      angle = i * 2.0 * Math::PI / 8
      x1 = cx + radius * 0.22 * Math.cos(angle)
      z1 = cz + radius * 0.22 * Math.sin(angle)
      x2 = cx + radius * 0.72 * Math.cos(angle + 0.12)
      z2 = cz + radius * 0.72 * Math.sin(angle + 0.12)

      rail(
        g.entities, "Nan_mam_#{i + 1}",
        x1, z1, x2, z2,
        8.mm, y - 2.mm, 2.mm, grey
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------------- DUNG BANG ----------------
  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation("LOP 66 - Bang quang cao 3D", true)

    begin
      # Vat lieu
      black = mat(model, "Nen_den_than",
                  [24, 24, 29])

      dark = mat(model, "Khung_thep",
                 [45, 47, 50])

      orange = mat(model, "Vang_cam",
                   [255, 167, 0])

      yellow = mat(model, "Vang_sang",
                   [255, 190, 20])

      white = mat(model, "Trang",
                  [244, 244, 240])

      grey = mat(model, "Nhom_bac",
                 [165, 169, 175])

      tyre_black = mat(model, "Cao_su",
                       [32, 32, 34])

      # Xoa model cu neu chay lai
      model.entities.grep(Sketchup::Group).each do |g|
        g.erase! if g.name == MODEL_NAME
      end

      root = model.entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME
      e = root.entities

      half_w = W / 2.0
      front_y = -PANEL_T

      # ======================================================
      # 1. TAM NEN DEN
      # ======================================================
      box(
        e, "01_Tam_nen_den",
        -half_w, -PANEL_T, 0,
        W, PANEL_T, H,
        black
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 2. VIEN KHUNG
      # ======================================================
      box(e, "Vien_tren",
          -half_w, -PANEL_T - FRAME_D, H - FRAME_T,
          W, FRAME_D, FRAME_T, orange)

      box(e, "Vien_duoi",
          -half_w, -PANEL_T - FRAME_D, 0,
          W, FRAME_D, FRAME_T, orange)

      box(e, "Vien_trai",
          -half_w, -PANEL_T - FRAME_D, 0,
          FRAME_T, FRAME_D, H, orange)

      box(e, "Vien_phai",
          half_w - FRAME_T, -PANEL_T - FRAME_D, 0,
          FRAME_T, FRAME_D, H, orange)

      # ======================================================
      # 3. CHU LOP 66
      # ======================================================
      text3d(
        e, "03_CHU_LOP_66",
        "LOP 66",
        -400.mm, 720.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        TITLE_H,
        "Arial",
        true,
        yellow,
        TITLE_D
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 4. HINH LOP XE BEN TRAI
      # ======================================================
      tire_icon(
        e,
        -2250.mm, 650.mm,
        260.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        tyre_black, grey, orange
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 5. HAI ICON MAM XE BEN PHAI
      # ======================================================
      wheel_icon(
        e,
        1050.mm, 760.mm,
        115.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        grey, white
      )

      wheel_icon(
        e,
        2200.mm, 760.mm,
        115.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        grey, white
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 6. CHU LOP XE CHINH HANG
      # ======================================================
      text3d(
        e, "06_Lop_xe_1",
        "LOP XE",
        1400.mm, 730.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        95.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        white,
        SMALL_D
      )

      text3d(
        e, "06_Chinh_hang_1",
        "CHINH HANG",
        1400.mm, 630.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        50.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        orange,
        SMALL_D
      )

      text3d(
        e, "07_Lop_xe_2",
        "LOP XE",
        2500.mm, 730.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        95.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        white,
        SMALL_D
      )

      text3d(
        e, "07_Chinh_hang_2",
        "CHINH HANG",
        2500.mm, 630.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        50.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        orange,
        SMALL_D
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 7. DAI THONG TIN DUOI
      # ======================================================
      box(
        e, "08_Dai_thong_tin_trang",
        -half_w, -PANEL_T - 1.mm, 0,
        W, 2.mm, INFO_H,
        white
      )

      # Dia chi
      text3d(
        e, "09_Dia_chi",
        "66 DINH TIEN HOANG, BMT, DAK LAK",
        -1350.mm, 95.mm,
        -PANEL_T - 4.mm,
        55.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        dark,
        SMALL_D
      )

      # So dien thoai
      text3d(
        e, "10_SDT_1",
        "0981 217 430",
        1050.mm, 95.mm,
        -PANEL_T - 4.mm,
        55.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        dark,
        SMALL_D
      )

      text3d(
        e, "11_SDT_2",
        "0914 582 952",
        2300.mm, 95.mm,
        -PANEL_T - 4.mm,
        55.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        dark,
        SMALL_D
      )

      # Duong phan cach khu vuc thong tin
      box(
        e, "Duong_phan_cach_1",
        300.mm, -PANEL_T - 3.mm, 25.mm,
        3.mm, 3.mm, INFO_H - 50.mm,
        grey
      )

      box(
        e, "Duong_phan_cach_2",
        1750.mm, -PANEL_T - 3.mm, 25.mm,
        3.mm, 3.mm, INFO_H - 50.mm,
        grey
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 8. KHUNG THEP PHIA SAU
      # ======================================================
      back_y = 15.mm
      tube = 40.mm

      # Thanh ngang sau
      box(
        e, "Khung_sau_tren",
        -half_w + 50.mm, back_y, H - 100.mm,
        W - 100.mm, tube, tube, dark
      )

      box(
        e, "Khung_sau_giua",
        -half_w + 50.mm, back_y, H / 2.0,
        W - 100.mm, tube, tube, dark
      )

      box(
        e, "Khung_sau_duoi",
        -half_w + 50.mm, back_y, 50.mm,
        W - 100.mm, tube, tube, dark
      )

      # Thanh dung
      [-half_w + 100.mm, 0, half_w - 100.mm].each_with_index do |x, i|
        box(
          e, "Khung_sau_dung_#{i + 1}",
          x, back_y, 50.mm,
          tube, tube, H - 100.mm, dark
        )
      end

      # ======================================================
      # 9. HOAN TAT
      # ======================================================
      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents
      model.commit_operation

      puts "Da tao xong bang hieu LOP 66."
      puts "Kich thuoc: #{W.to_mm} x #{H.to_mm} mm."
      root

    rescue => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "Loi: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
      raise
    end
  end
end

module TiemNhaOc3D

  extend self

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. THÔNG SỐ KÍCH THƯỚC
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  W = 4000.0       # Chiều rộng biển
  H = 1200.0       # Chiều cao biển
  D = 120.0        # Chiều sâu hộp biển

  PANEL_MARGIN = 32.0
  BORDER_W     = 22.0
  CORNER_CUT   = 42.0

  FACE_Y       = -4.0
  TEXT_DEPTH   = 16.0
  TEXT_RAISE    = 5.0

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. KHỞI TẠO MODEL
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  model = Sketchup.active_model
  model.start_operation('Dung bien hieu Tiem Nha Oc 3D', true)

  begin

    # Xóa nhóm mô hình cũ do script này tạo
    old = model.entities.grep(Sketchup::Group).find do |g|
      g.name == 'TIEM_NHA_OC_3D'
    end

    old.erase! if old && old.valid?

    root = model.entities.add_group
    root.name = 'TIEM_NHA_OC_3D'
    root.description = 'Bien hieu Tiem Nha Oc - mo hinh 3D'

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. VẬT LIỆU
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    materials = model.materials

    def get_material(materials, name, color, alpha = 1.0)
      mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
      mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(
        color[0], color[1], color[2], (alpha * 255).to_i
      )
      mat.alpha = alpha
      mat
    end

    mat_body = get_material(
      materials, 'OC_Body_Dark_Brown', [47, 34, 43]
    )

    mat_face = get_material(
      materials, 'OC_Face_Brown', [53, 37, 44]
    )

    mat_gold = get_material(
      materials, 'OC_Gold_Trim', [238, 166, 35]
    )

    mat_gold_light = get_material(
      materials, 'OC_Gold_Light', [255, 194, 43]
    )

    mat_red = get_material(
      materials, 'OC_Logo_Red', [235, 18, 56]
    )

    mat_red_side = get_material(
      materials, 'OC_Logo_Red_Side', [115, 15, 38]
    )

    mat_white = get_material(
      materials, 'OC_White_Text', [255, 250, 239]
    )

    mat_shadow = get_material(
      materials, 'OC_Text_Shadow', [20, 15, 19]
    )

    mat_metal = get_material(
      materials, 'OC_Frame_Metal', [70, 70, 74]
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. HÀM TẠO HỘP CHỮ NHẬT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def add_box(parent, name, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, material)
      group = parent.add_group
      group.name = name

      pts = [
        [x1, y1, z1],
        [x2, y1, z1],
        [x2, y1, z2],
        [x1, y1, z2]
      ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(p[0].mm, p[1].mm, p[2].mm) }

      face = group.entities.add_face(pts)
      raise "Khong tao duoc mat: #{name}" unless face

      face.reverse! if face.normal.y > 0

      face.pushpull((y2 - y1).mm)

      group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = material
        f.back_material = material
      end

      group
    end

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. HÀM TẠO TẤM PHẲNG TRÊN MẶT BIỂN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def add_front_polygon(parent, name, points, depth, material)
      group = parent.add_group
      group.name = name

      pts = points.map do |p|
        Geom::Point3d.new(p[0].mm, p[1].mm, p[2].mm)
      end

      face = group.entities.add_face(pts)
      raise "Loi tao polygon: #{name}" unless face

      face.reverse! if face.normal.y > 0
      face.pushpull(depth.mm)

      group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = material
        f.back_material = material
      end

      group
    end

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. HÀM TẠO THANH VIỀN THEO ĐƯỜNG BAO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def add_front_bar(parent, name, x1, z1, x2, z2,
                      width, y, material)

      dx = x2 - x1
      dz = z2 - z1
      len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)

      return nil if len < 0.001

      nx = -dz / len * width / 2.0
      nz =  dx / len * width / 2.0

      points = [
        [x1 + nx, y, z1 + nz],
        [x2 + nx, y, z2 + nz],
        [x2 - nx, y, z2 - nz],
        [x1 - nx, y, z1 - nz]
      ]

      add_front_polygon(
        parent, name, points, 3.0, material
      )
    end

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def add_text_3d(parent, name, text, x, z, height,
                    material, font = 'Arial',
                    bold = true, depth = 12.0,
                    align = :center)

      group = parent.add_group
      group.name = name

      alignment = case align

                  else
                    TextAlignCenter = 1

      ok = group.entities.add_3d_text(
        text,

        height.mm,

        depth.mm
      )

      unless ok

      end

      group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|

      # Xoay mặt chữ đứng: mặt XY -> mặt XZ
      rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees
      )

      group.transform!(rotation)

      # Đưa chân chữ đến vị trí thiết kế
      translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(x.mm, FACE_Y.mm, z.mm)
      )

      group.transform!(translation)

      group
    end

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. HỘP BIỂN CHÍNH
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    body = add_box(

# encoding: UTF-8
# ============================================================
# ADMAKE - BIEN BAO DU AN / SKETCHUP RUBY API
# Dung hinh 3D theo anh bien bao ngoai troi
# Don vi: mm
# ============================================================

module ADMAKE_BienBaoDuAn
  extend self

  W = 3000.mm
  H = 1800.mm
  THICKNESS = 35.mm
  POST_H = 3500.mm
  POST_SIZE = 60.mm
  FRAME = 25.mm
  TEXT_DEPTH = 3.mm

  def material(name, rgb)
    mats = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    m = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def block(entities, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    pts = [
      [x,      y,      z],
      [x + dx, y,      z],
      [x + dx, y + dy, z],
      [x,      y + dy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(p) }

    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    if f
      f.material = mat
      f.back_material = mat
      f.pushpull(dz)
    end
    g
  end

  def text3d(entities, string, x, y, z, height, mat, bold = true)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "Chu_#{string.gsub(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/, '_')}"

    ok = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      string,
      1,
      "Arial",
      bold,
      false,
      height,
      0,
      0,
      true,
      TEXT_DEPTH
    )

    unless ok
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Chu tao tren mat XY, xoay dung len mat bien.
    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation([x, y, z]) *
      Geom::Transformation.rotation(ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees)
    )

    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      f.material = mat
      f.back_material = mat
    end

    g
  end

  def run
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation("ADMAKE Bien Bao Du An", true)

    begin
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = "BIEN_BAO_DOI_SAN_XUAT_KO_SIER_II"
      e = root.entities

      blue = material("Nen_xanh_duong", [20, 65, 175])
      white = material("Nen_trang", [245, 246, 248])
      red = material("Chu_do", [177, 42, 49])
      navy = material("Chu_xanh_dam", [20, 50, 105])
      silver = material("Nhom_bac", [175, 185, 192])
      steel = material("Thep_tru", [135, 145, 150])
      concrete = material("Be_tong_mong", [145, 145, 140])

      half_w = W / 2.0
      z0 = 1800.mm
      front_y = -THICKNESS / 2.0 - 2.mm

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # MONG BE TONG VA TRU THEP
      # ------------------------------------------------
      [-1, 1].each do |side|
        px = side * (half_w - 100.mm)

        block(
          e, "Mong_tru_#{side}",
          px - 130.mm, -130.mm, 0,
          260.mm, 260.mm, 400.mm, concrete
        )

        block(
          e, "Tru_thep_#{side}",
          px - POST_SIZE / 2.0,
          -POST_SIZE / 2.0,
          400.mm,
          POST_SIZE, POST_SIZE,
          POST_H - 400.mm, steel
        )

        block(
          e, "Nap_tru_#{side}",
          px - POST_SIZE / 2.0,
          -POST_SIZE / 2.0,
          POST_H,
          POST_SIZE, POST_SIZE, 5.mm, silver
        )
      end

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # TAM BIEN CHINH
      # ------------------------------------------------
      block(
        e, "Tam_bien_nen",
        -half_w, -THICKNESS / 2.0, z0,
        W, THICKNESS, H, blue
      )

      # Khu vuc noi dung phia duoi
      lower_h = 700.mm
      block(
        e, "Nen_thong_tin_trang",
        -half_w + FRAME,
        front_y,
        z0 + FRAME,
        W - 2 * FRAME, 3.mm,
        lower_h, white
      )

      # Dai ngan cach xanh
      block(
        e, "Duong_phan_cach",
        -half_w + FRAME,
        front_y - 4.mm,
        z0 + lower_h + FRAME,
        W - 2 * FRAME, 3.mm, 15.mm, white
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # KHUNG VIEN NHOM
      # ------------------------------------------------
      block(e, "Vien_tren",
        -half_w, -THICKNESS / 2.0 - 5.mm,
        z0 + H - FRAME,
        W, 5.mm, FRAME, silver)

      block(e, "Vien_duoi",
        -half_w, -THICKNESS / 2.0 - 5.mm,
        z0,
        W, 5.mm, FRAME, silver)

      block(e, "Vien_trai",
        -half_w, -THICKNESS / 2.0 - 5.mm,
        z0,
        FRAME, 5.mm, H, silver)

      block(e, "Vien_phai",
        half_w - FRAME, -THICKNESS / 2.0 - 5.mm,
        z0,
        FRAME, 5.mm, H, silver)

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # CHU TIEU DE NOI
      # ------------------------------------------------
      text3d(
        e, "ĐỘI SẢN XUẤT",
        0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + H - 450.mm,
        180.mm, red, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "KÔ SIÊR II",
        0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + H - 800.mm,
        180.mm, red, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "ĐC: TỔ LIÊN GIA 19, B. KÔ SIÊR, P. BUÔN MA THUỘT, ĐẮK LẮK",
        0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + H - 970.mm,
        35.mm, navy, true
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # KHU VUC THONG TIN BEN DUOI
      # ------------------------------------------------
      # Cot trai
      text3d(
        e, "ĐƠN VỊ CUNG ỨNG",
        -W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 570.mm,
        45.mm, navy, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "PHÂN BÓN & THUỐC BVTV",
        -W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 460.mm,
        40.mm, navy, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "BACONCO",
        -W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 280.mm,
        32.mm, navy, true
      )

      # Cot phai
      text3d(
        e, "ĐƠN VỊ TƯ VẤN KỸ THUẬT",
        W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 570.mm,
        42.mm, navy, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "& CUNG ỨNG VẬT TƯ",
        W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 485.mm,
        42.mm, navy, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "NPP THÀNH DŨNG",
        W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 300.mm,
        68.mm, red, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "ĐT: 0983 00 47 53",
        W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 100.mm,
        38.mm, navy, true
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # HOAN TAT
      # ------------------------------------------------
      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents
      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da dung xong bien bao 3D.\n" \
        "Bang: 3000 x 1800 mm.\n" \
        "Hay kiem tra font chu va chinh lai kich thuoc theo hien truong."
      )

    rescue => ex
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox("Loi Ruby: #{ex.message}")
    end
  end
end

module KoSierSign3D
  extend self

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 01. THONG SO
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  W = 6000.0
  H = 3000.0
  D = 100.0

  Z0 = 2600.0
  POST_H = 5900.0

  POST_X = 150.0
  POST_R = 65.0

  FRAME = 45.0
  FACE_Y = -D

  BLUE_H = 1800.0
  WHITE_H = H - BLUE_H

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 02. VAT LIEU
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def material(model, name, rgb)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2])
    m
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 03. CAC HAM TAO HINH
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def point(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(x.mm, y.mm, z.mm)
  end

  # Tao khoi hop bang 6 mat
  def box(parent, name, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, mat)
    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    faces = [
      [[x1,y1,z1],[x1,y2,z1],[x2,y2,z1],[x2,y1,z1]],
      [[x1,y1,z2],[x2,y1,z2],[x2,y2,z2],[x1,y2,z2]],
      [[x1,y1,z1],[x2,y1,z1],[x2,y1,z2],[x1,y1,z2]],
      [[x1,y2,z1],[x1,y2,z2],[x2,y2,z2],[x2,y2,z1]],
      [[x1,y1,z1],[x1,y1,z2],[x1,y2,z2],[x1,y2,z1]],
      [[x2,y1,z1],[x2,y2,z1],[x2,y2,z2],[x2,y1,z2]]
    ]

    faces.each do |coords|
      f = e.add_face(coords.map { |p| point(p[0],p[1],p[2]) })
      next unless f
      f.material = mat
      f.back_material = mat
    end

    g
  end

  # Thanh hop chay theo phuong X
  def beam_x(parent, name, x1, x2, y, z, width, depth, mat)
    box(parent, name,
        x1, y-depth/2.0, z-width/2.0,
        x2, y+depth/2.0, z+width/2.0, mat)
  end

  # Thanh hop chay theo phuong Z
  def beam_z(parent, name, x, y, z1, z2, width, depth, mat)
    box(parent, name,
        x-width/2.0, y-depth/2.0, z1,
        x+width/2.0, y+depth/2.0, z2, mat)
  end

  # Tao tru tron dung theo truc Z
  def cylinder_z(parent, name, x, y, z1, z2, radius, mat, sides=32)
    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name

    center = point(x,y,z1)
    edges = g.entities.add_circle(center, Z_AXIS, radius.mm, sides)
    face = g.entities.add_face(edges)

    if face
      face.material = mat
      face.back_material = mat
      face.pushpull((z2-z1).mm)

      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = mat
        f.back_material = mat
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # Tam da giac/tam da giac bat ky tren mat XZ
  def front_polygon(parent, name, coords, y, thickness, mat)
    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name

    pts = coords.map { |p| point(p[0], y, p[1]) }
    face = g.entities.add_face(pts)

    if face
      face.material = mat
      face.back_material = mat
      face.reverse! if face.normal.y > 0
      face.pushpull(thickness.mm)

      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = mat
        f.back_material = mat
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # Tao chu noi va can giua theo bounding box.
  # Chu duoc xoay dung len mat bien, extrusion huong ra phia truoc.
  def text_3d(parent, name, str, cx, baseline_z, height,
              mat, font='Arial', bold=true, depth=8.0)

    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name


  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    entities = model.active_entities
    m_blue = material(model, "Mat_Blue", [0, 100, 200])
    m_white = material(model, "Mat_White", [250, 250, 250])
    box(entities, "Khung", 0, 0, 0, 3300, 250, 3300, m_blue)
    box(entities, "Mat_Pano", 0, 130, 0, 3234, 10, 3234, m_white)
  end
end

module XeDienThuHien3D

  W       = 5000.mm

  TOP     = BOTTOM + H

  def material(model, name, rgb)

# ============================================================
# BUN DAU CO HAU - SIGNBOARD 3D
# SketchUp Ruby API | Units: mm
# ============================================================

module BunDauCoHau3D
  extend self

  # KICH THUOC BANG
  W = 4000.mm
  H = 1800.mm
  FRAME = 40.mm
  PANEL_D = 35.mm
  LETTER_D = 18.mm

  def material(name, rgb)
    mats = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    m = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, w, h, d, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = [
      [x,y,z], [x+w,y,z], [x+w,y,z+h], [x,y,z+h]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    if f
      f.reverse! if f.normal.y > 0
      f.pushpull(d)
      g.material = mat
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
        face.material = mat
        face.back_material = mat
      end
    end
    g
  end

  # Chu noi tren mat dung, truc ngang X, truc cao Z
  def raised_text(entities, name, string, x, z,
                  height, width, face_mat,
                  font = "Arial", bold = true, depth = LETTER_D)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        string,
        TextAlignCenter,
        font,
        bold,
        false,
        height,
        0.5.mm,
        true,
        depth
      )
    rescue
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    b = g.bounds
    return g if b.width <= 0

    sx = width.to_f / b.width
    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.scaling(
        Geom::Point3d.new(0,0,0), sx, 1, 1
      )
    )

    b = g.bounds
    cx = (b.min.x + b.max.x) / 2.0
    min_y = b.min.y

    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(-cx, -min_y, 0)
      )
    )

    # Xoay chu de mat chu huong ra phia truoc (-Y)
    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        Geom::Point3d.new(0,0,0),
        Geom::Vector3d.new(1,0,0),
        90.degrees
      )
    )

    b = g.bounds
    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(x, -PANEL_D - depth, z - b.min.z)
      )
    )

    g.material = face_mat
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = face_mat
      face.back_material = face_mat
    end
    g
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation("Bun Dau Co Hau 3D", true)

    begin
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = "BANG HIEU BUN DAU CO HAU"
      e = root.entities

      black  = material("CDH Khung den", [20,20,24])
      teal   = material("CDH Ton xanh ngoc", [0,165,145])
      teal2  = material("CDH Ton song toi", [0,125,115])
      yellow = material("CDH Chu vang", [255,190,0])
      white  = material("CDH Chu trang", [245,243,255])
      orange = material("CDH Dia chi cam", [225,145,65])
      dark   = material("CDH Bong chu den", [18,16,25])

      # TAM BANG
      box(e, "Nen ton xanh ngoc",
          0, 0, 0, W, H, PANEL_D, teal)

      # TON SONG DOC - cac nep noi
      rib_count = 68
      rib_spacing = W.to_f / rib_count

      rib_count.times do |i|
        x = i * rib_spacing
        box(e, "Nep ton doc #{i+1}",
            x, -2.mm, 0,
            7.mm, H, 3.mm, teal2)
      end

      # KHUNG VIEN CHU NHAT
      box(e, "Vien tren", 0, -45.mm, H-FRAME,
          W, FRAME, 45.mm, black)
      box(e, "Vien duoi", 0, -45.mm, 0,
          W, FRAME, 45.mm, black)
      box(e, "Vien trai", 0, -45.mm, 0,
          FRAME, H, 45.mm, black)
      box(e, "Vien phai", W-FRAME, -45.mm, 0,
          FRAME, H, 45.mm, black)

      # DONG CHU CHINH
      raised_text(e, "Chu BUN",
          "BUN", 600.mm, 1190.mm,
          360.mm, 850.mm, white, "Arial", true, 22.mm)

      raised_text(e, "Chu DAU",
          "DAU", 1250.mm, 830.mm,
          310.mm, 850.mm, white, "Arial", true, 22.mm)

      raised_text(e, "Chu CO HAU",
          "CO HAU", 2220.mm, 850.mm,
          350.mm, 1550.mm, yellow, "Arial", true, 25.mm)

      # DONG PHU
      raised_text(e, "Huong vi Ha Thanh",
          "HUONG VI HA THANH",
          2050.mm, 440.mm,
          215.mm, 2350.mm,
          yellow, "Arial", true, 18.mm)

      # DIA CHI
      raised_text(e, "Dia chi",
          "2122 PHAM THE HIEN P6 Q8",
          1550.mm, 135.mm,
          100.mm, 2000.mm,
          orange, "Arial", true, 6.mm)

      # BIEU TUONG NHA DON GIAN
      # Mai nha
      roof = e.add_group
      roof.name = "Icon nha"
      pts = [
        [260.mm,-50.mm,190.mm],
        [390.mm,-50.mm,310.mm],
        [520.mm,-50.mm,190.mm]
      ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }
      face = roof.entities.add_face(pts)
      face.material = orange if face

      box(e, "Than nha", 300.mm, -50.mm, 80.mm,
          180.mm, 120.mm, 6.mm, orange)

      # KHUNG GIA DO PHIA SAU
      box(e, "Thanh ngang sau",
          100.mm, 30.mm, 100.mm,
          W-200.mm, 50.mm, 50.mm, black)

      # XEM TOAN BO MO HINH
      model.active_view.zoom(root)
      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da dung xong bang hieu BUN DAU CO HAU 3D.\n" \
        "Kich thuoc: 4000 x 1800 mm.\n" \
        "Luu mo hinh bang File > Save As."
      )
    rescue => ex
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox("Loi: #{ex.message}")
      raise ex
    end
  end
end

# encoding: UTF-8
# ============================================================
# CHU INOX VANG GUONG 3D - SKETCHUP RUBY
# Dung chu noi kim loai, mat guong vang, canh extrude day.
# SketchUp Ruby API
# ============================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module ADMAKE_GOLD_LETTERS

  extend self

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. CAU HINH
  # Don vi nhap: mm
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  CONFIG = {
    group_name:       'ADMAKE_CHU_INOX_VANG_GUONG',
    main_text:        'GOLD',
    sub_text:         'IN THUOC',
    font_main:        'Arial Black',
    font_sub:         'Arial',
    main_height:      220.0,
    sub_height:       65.0,
    letter_depth:     25.0,
    sub_depth:        12.0,
    spacing:          8.0,
    sub_spacing:      5.0,
    bevel_size:       1.2,
    board_width:      1200.0,
    board_height:     450.0,
    board_thickness:  5.0,
    make_board:       false,
    rotate_z:         -12.0,
    gold_color:       [235, 177, 35],
    side_color:       [173, 112, 18],
    dark_gold_color:  [75, 45, 8],
    board_color:      [245, 245, 242],
    create_bom:       true
  }.freeze

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. VAT LIEU
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def create_material(model, name, color, metallic = false)
    mat = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = 1.0

    # Reflection-related rendering differs by SketchUp version.
    # A strong gold color is used as a portable fallback.
    if mat.respond_to?(:metallic=)
      mat.metallic = metallic ? 1.0 : 0.0
    end

    mat
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. TAO MAT PHANG TU HINH CHU NHAT
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, material, name)
    group = entities.add_group
    group.name = name
    pts = [
      [x,      y,      z],
      [x + sx, y,      z],
      [x + sx, y + sy, z],
      [x,      y + sy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    face = group.entities.add_face(pts)
    if face
      face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
      face.pushpull(sz)
      group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = material
        f.back_material = material
      end
    end

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. TAO CHU 3D
  # SketchUp Text geometry is converted to faces when possible.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_3d_text(parent, text, height, depth, font,
                  front_mat, side_mat, x, y, z, group_name)

    group = parent.add_group
    group.name = group_name
    ents = group.entities

    begin
      # add_3d_text(text, alignment, font, bold, italic,
      #             height, tolerance, z, filled, extrusion)
      ents.add_3d_text(
        text,
        TextAlignLeft = 0,
        font,
        true,
        false,
        height.mm,
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        depth.mm
      )
    rescue => e
      UI.messagebox(
        "Khong tao duoc chu: #{text}\n" \
        "Kiem tra font '#{font}'.\n#{e.message}"
      )
      group.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Gan vat lieu theo mat truoc/sau.
    ents.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = front_mat
      face.back_material = front_mat
    end

    # Pushpull cua add_3d_text da tao canh ben.
    # Gan side material cho cac mat ben bang phan tich normal.
    ents.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      next if face.normal.z.abs > 0.98
      face.material = side_mat
      face.back_material = side_mat
    end

    # Dinh vi theo goc trai duoi.
    group.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation([x.mm, y.mm, z.mm])
    )

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. LAM TRON CANH NHE
  # Khong lam thay doi duong bien chu.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def soften_edges(group, angle = 20.degrees)
    return unless group && group.valid?

    group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Edge).each do |edge|
      begin
        edge.soft = true if edge.respond_to?(:soft=)
        edge.smooth = true if edge.respond_to?(:smooth=)
      rescue
        # Bo qua edge khong ho tro.
      end
    end
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. LAY KICH THUOC HINH HOC
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def bounds_size(group)
    bb = group.bounds
    [
      bb.width.to_mm,
      bb.height.to_mm,
      bb.depth.to_mm
    ]
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. TAO MO HINH CHINH
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ADMAKE - Chu inox vang guong 3D', true)

    begin
      # Vat lieu
      gold = create_material(
        model, 'INOX_VANG_GUONG',
        CONFIG[:gold_color], true
      )

      side = create_material(
        model, 'CANH_INOX_VANG',
        CONFIG[:side_color], true
      )

      dark_gold = create_material(
        model, 'MAT_TOP_VANG_BRONZE',
        CONFIG[:dark_gold_color], true
      )

      board_mat = create_material(
        model, 'NEN_TRANG',
        CONFIG[:board_color], false
      )

      # Group tong
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = CONFIG[:group_name]

      letters = root.entities.add_group
      letters.name = '01_CHU_NOI_3D'

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Chu dong
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      main = add_3d_text(
        letters,
        CONFIG[:main_text],
        CONFIG[:main_height],
        CONFIG[:letter_depth],
        CONFIG[:font_main],
        gold,
        side,
        0,
        0,
        CONFIG[:board_thickness],
        'CHU_DONG'
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Chu phu
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      sub = add_3d_text(
        letters,
        CONFIG[:sub_text],
        CONFIG[:sub_height],
        CONFIG[:sub_depth],
        CONFIG[:font_sub],
        gold,
        side,
        0,
        -CONFIG[:sub_height] * 1.5,
        CONFIG[:board_thickness],
        'CHU_PHU'
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Nen lap chu (tuy chon)
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      
      if CONFIG[:make_board]
        board = add_box(
          root.entities,
          -CONFIG[:board_width] * 0.03,
          -CONFIG[:board_height] * 0.30,
          0,
          CONFIG[:board_width],
          CONFIG[:board_height],
          CONFIG[:board_thickness],

        )
      end
    rescue => e
    ensure
      model.commit_operation
    end
  end
end
