require 'sketchup.rb'

module ADMAKE_COFFEE_SIGN

  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "ADMAKE - Coffee Tea 10 - Highcut Vintage"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. VẬT LIỆU
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def material(name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mats = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def materials
    {
      wall: material("Tuong - gach kem", [208, 201, 181]),
      brick: material("Mach gach", [125, 112, 96]),
      black: material("Chu noi - den", [24, 21, 18]),
      gold: material("Inox vang guong", [218, 164, 36]),
      gold_side: material("Canh chu - vang dong", [132, 91, 24]),
      warm: material("LED - vang am", [255, 190, 80]),
      white: material("Nen logo - trang", [242, 239, 226]),
      glass: material("Kinh - xam xanh", [80, 111, 115], 0.55),
      metal: material("Khung kim loai", [95, 99, 99]),
      red: material("Logo - do", [175, 20, 28])
    }
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. HÌNH HỘP 3D
  # Tọa độ: X ngang, Y chiều sâu, Z chiều cao
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    p000 = Geom::Point3d.new(x,      y,      z)
    p100 = Geom::Point3d.new(x + dx, y,      z)
    p110 = Geom::Point3d.new(x + dx, y + dy, z)
    p010 = Geom::Point3d.new(x,      y + dy, z)

    p001 = Geom::Point3d.new(x,      y,      z + dz)
    p101 = Geom::Point3d.new(x + dx, y,      z + dz)
    p111 = Geom::Point3d.new(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)
    p011 = Geom::Point3d.new(x,      y + dy, z + dz)

    faces = [
      [p000, p010, p110, p100],
      [p001, p101, p111, p011],
      [p000, p100, p101, p001],
      [p100, p110, p111, p101],
      [p110, p010, p011, p111],
      [p010, p000, p001, p011]
    ]

    faces.each do |pts|
      face = e.add_face(pts)
      next unless face
      face.material = mat
      face.back_material = mat
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. CHỮ NỔI 3D
  # Chữ nằm trên mặt đứng XZ, nhô ra phía trước theo -Y
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_text_3d(entities, name, text, x, y, z,
                  height, depth, front_mat, side_mat,
                  font = "Arial", bold = true)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    ok = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      text,
      Sketchup::TextAlignLeft,
      font,
      bold,
      false,
      height,
      1.mm,
      0,
      true,
      depth,
      front_mat
    )

    unless ok
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Tô vật liệu mặt sau/cạnh chữ
    g.entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
      entity.back_material = side_mat
      entity.material ||= front_mat
    end

    # Đưa mặt phẳng chữ XY thành mặt đứng XZ.
    # Trục đùn Z của chữ hướng ra phía trước theo -Y.
    origin = Geom::Point3d.new(x, y, z)
    xaxis  = Geom::Vector3d.new(1, 0, 0)
    yaxis  = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, 0, 1)
    zaxis  = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, -1, 0)

    g.transformation = Geom::Transformation.axes(
      origin, xaxis, yaxis, zaxis
    )

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. KHUNG / VIỀN TRANG TRÍ
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_frame(entities, x, y, z, w, h, bar, depth, mat, prefix)
    add_box(entities, "#{prefix} - Vien tren",
            x, y, z + h - bar, w, depth, bar, mat)

    add_box(entities, "#{prefix} - Vien duoi",
            x, y, z, w, depth, bar, mat)

    add_box(entities, "#{prefix} - Vien trai",
            x, y, z, bar, depth, h, mat)

    add_box(entities, "#{prefix} - Vien phai",
            x + w - bar, y, z, bar, depth, h, mat)
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. BIỂN COFFEE & TEA 10
  # Chữ nổi vàng trên mặt tường, có cạnh tối tạo tương phản
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_coffee_sign(root, m)
    g = root.add_group
    g.name = "01 - COFFEE & TEA 10"
    e = g.entities

    # Kích thước quy ước của cụm chữ phía trên
    x = -2450.mm
    y = -80.mm
    z = 4650.mm
    width = 4900.mm

    # Tấm nền tối mỏng phía sau chữ, có thể tắt nếu dùng
    # phương án chữ gắn trực tiếp lên tường.
    add_box(e, "Nen sau chu Coffee Tea",
            x, y + 45.mm, z - 100.mm,
            width, 20.mm, 760.mm, m[:black])

    # Thanh gá chữ
    add_box(e, "Thanh lap dat tren",
            x + 100.mm, y + 15.mm, z - 60.mm,
            width - 200.mm, 30.mm, 25.mm, m[:metal])

    # Chữ chính
    add_text_3d(
      e, "Chu Coffee Tea 10",
      "Coffee & Tea 10",
      x + 140.mm, y, z + 100.mm,
      420.mm, 35.mm,
      m[:gold], m[:black],
      "Arial", true
    )

    # Viền đế phụ trợ phía sau chữ
    add_box(e, "Nep chan chu",
            x + 120.mm, y + 5.mm, z - 20.mm,
            width - 240.mm, 12.mm, 22.mm, m[:gold_side])

    # Bát/vấu gá liên kết vào tường
    [x + 250.mm, 0, x + width - 250.mm].each_with_index do |px, i|
      add_box(e, "Pat treo Coffee #{i + 1}",
              px, 20.mm, z + 120.mm,
              60.mm, 100.mm, 160.mm, m[:metal])
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. BIỂN HIGHCUT VINTAGE
  # Chữ đen nổi, nền sáng và lớp hắt sáng vàng ấm
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_highcut_sign(root, m)
    g = root.add_group
    g.name = "02 - HIGHCUT VINTAGE"
    e = g.entities

    x = -2200.mm
    y = -100.mm
    z = 3150.mm
    w = 4400.mm
    h = 650.mm

    # Đế nền sáng
    add_box(e, "Nen bien Highcut",
            x, y + 40.mm, z,
            w, 50.mm, h, m[:white])

    # Hộp hắt sáng phía sau
    add_box(e, "Hop LED sau bien",
            x + 30.mm, y + 10.mm, z + 25.mm,
            w - 60.mm, 30.mm, h - 50.mm, m[:warm])

    # Mặt nền phía trước
    add_box(e, "Mat nen trang",
            x + 50.mm, y - 5.mm, z + 45.mm,
            w - 100.mm, 12.mm, h - 90.mm, m[:white])

    # Chữ nổi màu đen
    add_text_3d(
      e, "Chu Highcut Vintage",
      "Highcut Vintage",
      x + 170.mm, y - 20.mm, z + 170.mm,
      350.mm, 38.mm,
      m[:black], m[:black],
      "Arial", true
    )

    # Nẹp kim loại dưới biển
    add_box(e, "Nep duoi Highcut",
            x, y + 25.mm, z - 20.mm,
            w, 45.mm, 25.mm, m[:metal])

    # Pat liên kết
    [x + 250.mm, x + w / 2, x + w - 250.mm].each_with_index do |px, i|
      add_box(e, "Pat Highcut #{i + 1}",
              px, 15.mm, z + 80.mm,
              70.mm, 100.mm, 100.mm, m[:metal])
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. LOGO TRÒN COFFEE
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder_y(entities, name, cx, y, cz,
                     radius, depth, mat, segments = 64)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    # Tạo đường tròn nằm trên mặt XZ
    pts = []
    segments.times do |i|
      a = 2.0 * Math::PI * i / segments
      pts << Geom::Point3d.new(
        cx + radius * Math.cos(a),
        y,
        cz + radius * Math.sin(a)
      )
    end

    face = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    if face
      face.material = mat
      face.back_material = mat
      face.pushpull(depth)
    end

    g
  end

  def build_round_logo(root, m)
    g = root.add_group
    g.name = "03 - LOGO COFFEE TRON"
    e = g.entities

    cx = 3000.mm
    y = -100.mm
    cz = 3800.mm
    r = 440.mm

    add_cylinder_y(e, "Vien logo kim loai",
                   cx, y, cz, r, 45.mm, m[:black])

    add_cylinder_y(e, "Mat logo trang",
                   cx, y - 3.mm, cz, r - 35.mm,
                   8.mm, m[:white])

    add_text_3d(
      e, "Logo Coffee",
      "COFFEE",
      cx - 270.mm, y - 20.mm, cz - 50.mm,
      105.mm, 12.mm,
      m[:black], m[:black],
      "Arial", true
    )

    # Biểu tượng hạt cà phê cách điệu bằng hai hình elip
    add_cylinder_y(e, "Hat ca phe trai",
                   cx - 70.mm, y - 8.mm, cz + 130.mm,
                   65.mm, 10.mm, m[:gold], 32)

    add_cylinder_y(e, "Hat ca phe phai",
                   cx + 70.mm, y - 8.mm, cz + 130.mm,
                   65.mm, 10.mm, m[:gold], 32)

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. TƯỜNG THAM CHIẾU, CỬA SỔ VÀ GẠCH
  # Dùng làm nền phối cảnh; có thể ẩn nhóm này khi xuất biển
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(root, m)
    g = root.add_group
    g.name = "00 - WALL REFERENCE"
    e = g.entities

    # Tường tham chiếu
    add_box(e, "Khoi tuong",
            -4000.mm, 100.mm, 0,
            8000.mm, 250.mm, 6000.mm, m[:wall])

    # Mảng cửa kính tầng trên
    add_box(e, "Kinh tren trai",
            -1500.mm, 80.mm, 5050.mm,
            1050.mm, 25.mm, 700.mm, m[:glass])

    add_box(e, "Kinh tren phai",
            200.mm, 80.mm, 5050.mm,
            1050.mm, 25.mm, 700.mm, m[:glass])

    # Khung cửa sổ
    add_frame(e, -1550.mm, 60.mm, 5000.mm,
              1150.mm, 800.mm, 35.mm, 30.mm,
              m[:metal], "Khung kinh trai")

    add_frame(e, 150.mm, 60.mm, 5000.mm,
              1150.mm, 800.mm, 35.mm, 30.mm,
              m[:metal], "Khung kinh phai")

    # Các đường mạch gạch tham chiếu
    12.times do |i|
      zz = 200.mm + i * 280.mm
      add_box(e, "Mach gach #{i + 1}",
              -4000.mm, 95.mm, zz,
              8000.mm, 5.mm, 3.mm, m[:brick])
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. CHẠY DỰNG MÔ HÌNH
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation("ADMAKE - Dung bien hieu 3D", true)

    begin
      m = materials

      # Nhóm tổng để quản lý toàn bộ mô hình
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME
      e = root.entities

      # Tường tham chiếu
      build_wall(e, m)

      # Hai cụm biển chính
      build_coffee_sign(e, m)
      build_highcut_sign(e, m)
      build_round_logo(e, m)

      # Đưa camera nhìn toàn mô hình
      model.active_view.zoom_extents
      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Đã dựng xong mô hình biển hiệu 3D.\\n" \
        "Các cấu kiện được nhóm riêng để chỉnh sửa.\\n" \
        "Kích thước là quy ước ban đầu, cần hiệu chỉnh theo đo đạc."
      )

    rescue => error
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox(
        "Lỗi khi dựng mô hình:\\n#{error.message}\\n" \
        "#{error.backtrace.first}"
      )
    end
  end

  unless file_loaded?(__FILE__)
    UI.menu("Extensions").add_item(
      "ADMAKE - Dung bien Coffee Tea 10"
    ) {
      build
    }
    file_loaded(__FILE__)
  end

end

module BanhBaoTuoi3D
  extend self

  # ---------------- PARAMETERS ----------------
  W = 6000.mm
  H = 1200.mm
  D = 100.mm

  PANEL_BOTTOM = 2800.mm
  RAIL_H = 35.mm
  RIB_COUNT = 72

  def material(model, name, rgb)
    mats = model.materials
    m = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, w, d, h, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = [
      [x,y,z], [x+w,y,z], [x+w,y+d,z], [x,y+d,z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    face = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    face.reverse! if face.normal.y < 0
    face.pushpull(h)

    g.material = mat
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      f.material = mat
      f.back_material = mat
    end
    g
  end

  def beam_between(entities, name, p1, p2, width, depth, mat)
    a = Geom::Point3d.new(*p1)
    b = Geom::Point3d.new(*p2)
    v = b - a
    length = v.length
    return if length < 0.1

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = [
      [0,0,0], [width,0,0],
      [width,depth,0], [0,depth,0]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    f.pushpull(length)
    g.material = mat
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = mat
      face.back_material = mat
    end

    tr = Geom::Transformation.new(
      Geom::Point3d.new(*p1),
      Geom::Vector3d.new(0,0,1),
      Geom::Vector3d.new(1,0,0),
      v
    )
    # Stable alternative: align local Z to beam direction
    tr = Geom::Transformation.new(a) *
         Geom::Transformation.rotation(
           ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 0
         )
    direction = v.normalize
    rotation_axis = Z_AXIS.cross(direction)
    if rotation_axis.length > 0.0001
      angle = Z_AXIS.angle_between(direction)
      tr = Geom::Transformation.new(a) *
           Geom::Transformation.rotation(ORIGIN, rotation_axis, angle)
    end
    g.transform!(tr)
    g
  end

  def raised_text(entities, text, name, x, z, height,
                  face_mat, font = 'Arial',
                  bold = true, italic = false,
                  extrusion = 12.mm)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    ok = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      text,
      TextAlignCenter = 1,
      font,
      bold,
      italic,
      height,
      0.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      extrusion
    )

    unless ok

# ============================================================
# 3D GOLD LED CHANNEL LETTERS - DEL
# SketchUp Ruby API
# Units: mm
# Features:
# - 3D extruded lettering
# - Mirror gold sidewalls
# - Amber illuminated front faces
# - LED-like perforation details
# - Individual groups for each letter
# ============================================================

module GoldLEDLetters
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "DEL_GOLD_LED_3D"

  # Dimensions (mm)
  LETTER_HEIGHT = 500.mm
  LETTER_DEPTH  = 100.mm
  SIDE_THICKNESS = 2.mm
  BORDER_WIDTH = 12.mm
  LED_RADIUS = 5.mm
  LED_SPACING = 25.mm
  LETTER_GAP = 35.mm

  def material(model, name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mat = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)
    entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)

      entity.material =
        entity.normal.z > 0.8 ? front_mat : gold_mat

      entity.back_material = gold_mat
    end
  end

  def add_led_dot(entities, center, radius, mat)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      Z_AXIS,
      radius,
      12
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return unless face

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
  end

  def create_letter(model, character, x_position,
                    front_mat, gold_mat, led_mat)

    group = model.active_entities.add_group
    group.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

    entities = group.entities

    # Create extruded 3D text
    success = entities.add_3d_text(
      character,
      TextAlignCenter = 1,
      "Arial Black",
      true,
      false,
      LETTER_HEIGHT,
      0.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      LETTER_DEPTH
    )

    unless success
      group.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Apply gold and amber materials
    assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)

    # Bounding box
    bounds = group.bounds
    min_x = bounds.min.x
    min_y = bounds.min.y
    min_z = bounds.min.z

    # Place the letter on the baseline
    group.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          x_position - min_x,
          -min_y,
          -min_z
        )
      )
    )

    # LED detail along the front perimeter approximation
    # The dots are placed around the outer bounding box.
    bounds = group.bounds
    z_front = bounds.max.z + 1.mm

    x0 = bounds.min.x
    x1 = bounds.max.x
    y0 = bounds.min.y
    y1 = bounds.max.y

    # Top and bottom rows
    x = x0 + LED_SPACING
    while x < x1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y0, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y1, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      x += LED_SPACING
    end

    # Left and right rows
    y = y0 + LED_SPACING
    while y < y1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x0, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x1, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      y += LED_SPACING
    end

    group
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation(
      "Create Gold LED 3D Letters",
      true
    )

    begin
      # Materials
      gold = material(
        model,
        "Gold_Mirror",
        [184, 134, 45]
      )

      amber = material(
        model,
        "Amber_Illuminated_Face",
        [255, 166, 20]
      )

      led = material(
        model,
        "Warm_White_LED",
        [255, 230, 130]
      )

      # Root group
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME

      # Temporarily make root active for creating children
      model.active_entities.add_group

      # Build individual characters
      cursor = 0.0
      letters = ["D", "E", "L"]

      letters.each do |character|
        letter = root.entities.add_group
        letter.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

        result = letter.entities.add_3d_text(
          character,
          1,
          "Arial Black",
          true,
          false,
          LETTER_HEIGHT,
          0.5.mm,
          0,
          true,
          LETTER_DEPTH
        )

        if result
          assign_materials(
            letter.entities,
            amber,
            gold
          )

          bb = letter.bounds

          letter.transform!(
            Geom::Transformation.translation(
              Geom::Vector3d.new(
                cursor - bb.min.x,
                -bb.min.y,
                -bb.min.z
              )
            )
          )

          # Add luminous dots around each letter.
          bb = letter.bounds
          z = bb.max.z + 1.mm

          # Top and bottom rows
          px = bb.min.x + LED_SPACING

          while px < bb.max.x - LED_SPACING
            dot_group = root.entities.add_group
            c = dot_group.entities.add_circle(
              [px, bb.min.y, z],
              Z_AXIS,
              LED_RADIUS,
              12
            )

            f = dot_group.entities.add_face(c)
            if f
              f.material = led
              f.back_material = led
            end

            px += LED_SPACING
          end

          cursor += bb.width + LETTER_GAP
        end
      end

      # Remove the accidental empty group if present.
      model.active_entities.each do |entity|
        if entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Group) &&
           entity.entities.empty? &&
           entity != root
          entity.erase!
        end
      end

      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents

      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da tao mo hinh DEL 3D!\n" \
        "Chieu cao chu: 500 mm\n" \
        "Do day: 100 mm\n" \
        "Vat lieu: Gold + Amber LED"
      )

    rescue => e
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox(
        "Loi tao mo hinh:\n#{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.first}"
      )
    end
  end
end

    mat.alpha = alpha

        entity.normal.z > 0.8 ? front_mat : gold_mat

      entity.back_material = gold_mat

        end

# - LED-like perforation details
# - Individual groups for each letter
# ============================================================

module GoldLEDLetters
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "DEL_GOLD_LED_3D"

  # Dimensions (mm)
  LETTER_HEIGHT = 500.mm
  LETTER_DEPTH  = 100.mm
  SIDE_THICKNESS = 2.mm
  BORDER_WIDTH = 12.mm
  LED_RADIUS = 5.mm
  LED_SPACING = 25.mm
  LETTER_GAP = 35.mm

  def material(model, name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mat = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)
    entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)

      entity.material =
        entity.normal.z > 0.8 ? front_mat : gold_mat

      entity.back_material = gold_mat
    end
  end

  def add_led_dot(entities, center, radius, mat)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      Z_AXIS,
      radius,
      12
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return unless face

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
  end

  def create_letter(model, character, x_position,
                    front_mat, gold_mat, led_mat)

    group = model.active_entities.add_group
    group.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

    entities = group.entities

    # Create extruded 3D text
    success = entities.add_3d_text(
      character,
      TextAlignCenter = 1,
      "Arial Black",
      true,
      false,
      LETTER_HEIGHT,
      0.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      LETTER_DEPTH
    )

    unless success
      group.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Apply gold and amber materials
    assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)

    # Bounding box
    bounds = group.bounds
    min_x = bounds.min.x
    min_y = bounds.min.y
    min_z = bounds.min.z

    # Place the letter on the baseline
    group.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          x_position - min_x,
          -min_y,
          -min_z
        )
      )
    )

    # LED detail along the front perimeter approximation
    # The dots are placed around the outer bounding box.
    bounds = group.bounds
    z_front = bounds.max.z + 1.mm

    x0 = bounds.min.x
    x1 = bounds.max.x
    y0 = bounds.min.y
    y1 = bounds.max.y

    # Top and bottom rows
    x = x0 + LED_SPACING
    while x < x1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y0, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y1, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      x += LED_SPACING

        model.active_entities,
        [x0, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x1, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      y += LED_SPACING
    end

    group
  end

    model.start_operation(
      "Create Gold LED 3D Letters",
      true
    )

    begin
      # Materials
      gold = material(
        model,
        "Gold_Mirror",
        [184, 134, 45]
      )

      amber = material(
        model,
        "Amber_Illuminated_Face",
        [255, 166, 20]
      )

      led = material(
        model,
        "Warm_White_LED",
        [255, 230, 130]
      )

      # Root group
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME

      # Temporarily make root active for creating children
      model.active_entities.add_group

      # Build individual characters
      cursor = 0.0
      letters = ["D", "E", "L"]

      letters.each do |character|
        letter = root.entities.add_group
        letter.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

        result = letter.entities.add_3d_text(
          character,
          1,
          "Arial Black",
          true,
          false,
          LETTER_HEIGHT,
          0.5.mm,
          0,
          true,
          LETTER_DEPTH
        )

          assign_materials(
            letter.entities,
            amber,
            gold
          )

          bb = letter.bounds

          letter.transform!(
            Geom::Transformation.translation(
              Geom::Vector3d.new(
                cursor - bb.min.x,
                -bb.min.y,
                -bb.min.z
              )
            )
          )

          # Add luminous dots around each letter.
          bb = letter.bounds
          z = bb.max.z + 1.mm

          # Top and bottom rows
          px = bb.min.x + LED_SPACING

          while px < bb.max.x - LED_SPACING
            dot_group = root.entities.add_group
            c = dot_group.entities.add_circle(
              [px, bb.min.y, z],
              Z_AXIS,
              LED_RADIUS,
              12
            )

            f = dot_group.entities.add_face(c)
            if f
              f.material = led
              f.back_material = led
            end

            px += LED_SPACING
          end

          cursor += bb.width + LETTER_GAP
        end
      end

      # Remove the accidental empty group if present.
      model.active_entities.each do |entity|
        if entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Group) &&
           entity.entities.empty? &&
           entity != root
          entity.erase!
        end
      end

      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents

      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da tao mo hinh DEL 3D!\n" \
        "Chieu cao chu: 500 mm\n" \
        "Do day: 100 mm\n" \
        "Vat lieu: Gold + Amber LED"
      )

    rescue => e
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox(
        "Loi tao mo hinh:\n#{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.first}"
      )
    end
  end
end

#   8 | Tôn mạ màu chống thấm bảo vệ mặt | Tôn kẽm mạ màu 0.35mm che kín mặ |  0.2 | m²      |        95.000 |           19.000
#   9 | Bộ chữ nổi 3D thương hiệu phát s | Khổ bộ chữ 0.35m x 0.14m, mặt Mi |    1 | bộ      |     2.200.000 |        2.200.000
#  10 | Cần đỡ & Đèn pha LED chiếu rọi n | 2 cần vươn 1.2m + Đèn pha LED 50 |    2 | bộ      |       480.000 |          960.000

# 3. % Hao hụt vật tư: 5%

# ============================================================
# 3D GOLD LED CHANNEL LETTERS - DEL
# SketchUp Ruby API
# Units: mm
# Features:
# - 3D extruded lettering
# - Mirror gold sidewalls
# - Amber illuminated front faces
# - LED-like perforation details
# - Individual groups for each letter
# ============================================================

module GoldLEDLetters
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "DEL_GOLD_LED_3D"

  # Dimensions (mm)
  LETTER_HEIGHT = 500.mm
  LETTER_DEPTH  = 100.mm
  SIDE_THICKNESS = 2.mm
  BORDER_WIDTH = 12.mm
  LED_RADIUS = 5.mm
  LED_SPACING = 25.mm
  LETTER_GAP = 35.mm

  def material(model, name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mat = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)
    entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)

      entity.material =
        entity.normal.z > 0.8 ? front_mat : gold_mat

      entity.back_material = gold_mat
    end
  end

  def add_led_dot(entities, center, radius, mat)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      Z_AXIS,
      radius,
      12
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return unless face

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
  end

  def create_letter(model, character, x_position,
                    front_mat, gold_mat, led_mat)

    group = model.active_entities.add_group
    group.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

    entities = group.entities

    # Create extruded 3D text
    success = entities.add_3d_text(
      character,
      TextAlignCenter = 1,
      "Arial Black",
      true,
      false,
      LETTER_HEIGHT,
      0.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      LETTER_DEPTH
    )

    unless success
      group.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Apply gold and amber materials
    assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)

    # Bounding box
    bounds = group.bounds
    min_x = bounds.min.x
    min_y = bounds.min.y
    min_z = bounds.min.z

    # Place the letter on the baseline
    group.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          x_position - min_x,
          -min_y,
          -min_z
        )
      )
    )

    # LED detail along the front perimeter approximation
    # The dots are placed around the outer bounding box.
    bounds = group.bounds
    z_front = bounds.max.z + 1.mm

    x0 = bounds.min.x
    x1 = bounds.max.x
    y0 = bounds.min.y
    y1 = bounds.max.y

    # Top and bottom rows
    x = x0 + LED_SPACING
    while x < x1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y0, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y1, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      x += LED_SPACING
    end

    # Left and right rows
    y = y0 + LED_SPACING
    while y < y1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x0, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x1, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      y += LED_SPACING
    end

    group
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation(
      "Create Gold LED 3D Letters",
      true
    )

    begin
      # Materials
      gold = material(
        model,
        "Gold_Mirror",
        [184, 134, 45]
      )

      amber = material(
        model,
        "Amber_Illuminated_Face",
        [255, 166, 20]
      )

      led = material(
        model,
        "Warm_White_LED",
        [255, 230, 130]
      )

      # Root group
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME

      # Temporarily make root active for creating children
      model.active_entities.add_group

      # Build individual characters
      cursor = 0.0
      letters = ["D", "E", "L"]

      letters.each do |character|
        letter = root.entities.add_group
        letter.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

        result = letter.entities.add_3d_text(
          character,
          1,
          "Arial Black",
          true,
          false,
          LETTER_HEIGHT,
          0.5.mm,
          0,
          true,
          LETTER_DEPTH
        )

        if result
          assign_materials(
            letter.entities,
            amber,
            gold
          )

          bb = letter.bounds

          letter.transform!(
            Geom::Transformation.translation(
              Geom::Vector3d.new(
                cursor - bb.min.x,
                -bb.min.y,
                -bb.min.z
              )
            )
          )

          # Add luminous dots around each letter.
          bb = letter.bounds
          z = bb.max.z + 1.mm

          # Top and bottom rows
          px = bb.min.x + LED_SPACING

          while px < bb.max.x - LED_SPACING
            dot_group = root.entities.add_group
            c = dot_group.entities.add_circle(
              [px, bb.min.y, z],
              Z_AXIS,
              LED_RADIUS,
              12
            )

            f = dot_group.entities.add_face(c)
            if f
              f.material = led
              f.back_material = led
            end

            px += LED_SPACING
          end

          cursor += bb.width + LETTER_GAP
        end
      end

      # Remove the accidental empty group if present.
      model.active_entities.each do |entity|
        if entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Group) &&
           entity.entities.empty? &&
           entity != root
          entity.erase!
        end
      end

      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents

      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da tao mo hinh DEL 3D!\n" \
        "Chieu cao chu: 500 mm\n" \
        "Do day: 100 mm\n" \
        "Vat lieu: Gold + Amber LED"
      )

    rescue => e
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox(
        "Loi tao mo hinh:\n#{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.first}"
      )
    end
  end
end

# ============================================================
# 3D GOLD LED CHANNEL LETTERS - DEL
# SketchUp Ruby API
# Units: mm
# Features:
# - 3D extruded lettering
# - Mirror gold sidewalls
# - Amber illuminated front faces
# - LED-like perforation details
# - Individual groups for each letter
# ============================================================

module GoldLEDLetters
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "DEL_GOLD_LED_3D"

  # Dimensions (mm)
  LETTER_HEIGHT = 500.mm
  LETTER_DEPTH  = 100.mm
  SIDE_THICKNESS = 2.mm
  BORDER_WIDTH = 12.mm
  LED_RADIUS = 5.mm
  LED_SPACING = 25.mm
  LETTER_GAP = 35.mm

  def material(model, name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mat = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)
    entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)

      entity.material =
        entity.normal.z > 0.8 ? front_mat : gold_mat

      entity.back_material = gold_mat
    end
  end

  def add_led_dot(entities, center, radius, mat)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      Z_AXIS,
      radius,
      12
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return unless face

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
  end

  def create_letter(model, character, x_position,
                    front_mat, gold_mat, led_mat)

    group = model.active_entities.add_group
    group.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

    entities = group.entities

    # Create extruded 3D text
    success = entities.add_3d_text(
      character,
      TextAlignCenter = 1,
      "Arial Black",
      true,
      false,
      LETTER_HEIGHT,
      0.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      LETTER_DEPTH
    )

    unless success
      group.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Apply gold and amber materials
    assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)

    # Bounding box
    bounds = group.bounds
    min_x = bounds.min.x
    min_y = bounds.min.y
    min_z = bounds.min.z

    # Place the letter on the baseline
    group.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          x_position - min_x,
          -min_y,
          -min_z
        )
      )
    )

    # LED detail along the front perimeter approximation
    # The dots are placed around the outer bounding box.
    bounds = group.bounds
    z_front = bounds.max.z + 1.mm

    x0 = bounds.min.x
    x1 = bounds.max.x
    y0 = bounds.min.y
    y1 = bounds.max.y

    # Top and bottom rows
    x = x0 + LED_SPACING
    while x < x1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y0, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y1, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      x += LED_SPACING
    end

    # Left and right rows
    y = y0 + LED_SPACING
    while y < y1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x0, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x1, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      y += LED_SPACING
    end

    group
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation(
      "Create Gold LED 3D Letters",
      true
    )

    begin
      # Materials
      gold = material(
        model,
        "Gold_Mirror",
        [184, 134, 45]
      )

      amber = material(
        model,
        "Amber_Illuminated_Face",
        [255, 166, 20]
      )

      led = material(
        model,
        "Warm_White_LED",
        [255, 230, 130]
      )

      # Root group
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME

      # Temporarily make root active for creating children
      model.active_entities.add_group

      # Build individual characters
      cursor = 0.0
      letters = ["D", "E", "L"]

      letters.each do |character|
        letter = root.entities.add_group
        letter.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

        result = letter.entities.add_3d_text(
          character,
          1,
          "Arial Black",
          true,
          false,
          LETTER_HEIGHT,
          0.5.mm,
          0,
          true,
          LETTER_DEPTH
        )

        if result
          assign_materials(
            letter.entities,
            amber,
            gold
          )

          bb = letter.bounds

          letter.transform!(
            Geom::Transformation.translation(
              Geom::Vector3d.new(
                cursor - bb.min.x,
                -bb.min.y,
                -bb.min.z
              )
            )
          )

          # Add luminous dots around each letter.
          bb = letter.bounds
          z = bb.max.z + 1.mm

          # Top and bottom rows
          px = bb.min.x + LED_SPACING

          while px < bb.max.x - LED_SPACING
            dot_group = root.entities.add_group
            c = dot_group.entities.add_circle(
              [px, bb.min.y, z],
              Z_AXIS,
              LED_RADIUS,
              12
            )

            f = dot_group.entities.add_face(c)
            if f
              f.material = led
              f.back_material = led
            end

            px += LED_SPACING
          end

          cursor += bb.width + LETTER_GAP
        end
      end

      # Remove the accidental empty group if present.
      model.active_entities.each do |entity|
        if entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Group) &&
           entity.entities.empty? &&
           entity != root
          entity.erase!
        end
      end

      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents

      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da tao mo hinh DEL 3D!\n" \
        "Chieu cao chu: 500 mm\n" \
        "Do day: 100 mm\n" \
        "Vat lieu: Gold + Amber LED"
      )

    rescue => e
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox(
        "Loi tao mo hinh:\n#{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.first}"
      )
    end
  end
end

# ============================================================
# 3D GOLD LED CHANNEL LETTERS - DEL
# SketchUp Ruby API
# Units: mm
# Features:
# - 3D extruded lettering
# - Mirror gold sidewalls
# - Amber illuminated front faces
# - LED-like perforation details
# - Individual groups for each letter
# ============================================================

module GoldLEDLetters
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "DEL_GOLD_LED_3D"

  # Dimensions (mm)
  LETTER_HEIGHT = 500.mm
  LETTER_DEPTH  = 100.mm
  SIDE_THICKNESS = 2.mm
  BORDER_WIDTH = 12.mm
  LED_RADIUS = 5.mm
  LED_SPACING = 25.mm
  LETTER_GAP = 35.mm

  def material(model, name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mat = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)
    entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)

      entity.material =
        entity.normal.z > 0.8 ? front_mat : gold_mat

      entity.back_material = gold_mat
    end
  end

  def add_led_dot(entities, center, radius, mat)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      Z_AXIS,
      radius,
      12
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return unless face

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
  end

  def create_letter(model, character, x_position,
                    front_mat, gold_mat, led_mat)

    group = model.active_entities.add_group
    group.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

    entities = group.entities

    # Create extruded 3D text
    success = entities.add_3d_text(
      character,
      TextAlignCenter = 1,
      "Arial Black",
      true,
      false,
      LETTER_HEIGHT,
      0.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      LETTER_DEPTH
    )

    unless success
      group.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Apply gold and amber materials
    assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)

    # Bounding box
    bounds = group.bounds
    min_x = bounds.min.x
    min_y = bounds.min.y
    min_z = bounds.min.z

    # Place the letter on the baseline
    group.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          x_position - min_x,
          -min_y,
          -min_z
        )
      )
    )

    # LED detail along the front perimeter approximation
    # The dots are placed around the outer bounding box.
    bounds = group.bounds
    z_front = bounds.max.z + 1.mm

    x0 = bounds.min.x
    x1 = bounds.max.x
    y0 = bounds.min.y
    y1 = bounds.max.y

    # Top and bottom rows
    x = x0 + LED_SPACING
    while x < x1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y0, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y1, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      x += LED_SPACING
    end

    # Left and right rows
    y = y0 + LED_SPACING
    while y < y1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x0, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x1, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      y += LED_SPACING
    end

    group
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation(
      "Create Gold LED 3D Letters",
      true
    )

    begin
      # Materials
      gold = material(
        model,
        "Gold_Mirror",
        [184, 134, 45]
      )

      amber = material(
        model,
        "Amber_Illuminated_Face",
        [255, 166, 20]
      )

      led = material(
        model,
        "Warm_White_LED",
        [255, 230, 130]
      )

      # Root group
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME

      # Temporarily make root active for creating children
      model.active_entities.add_group

      # Build individual characters
      cursor = 0.0
      letters = ["D", "E", "L"]

      letters.each do |character|
        letter = root.entities.add_group
        letter.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

        result = letter.entities.add_3d_text(
          character,
          1,
          "Arial Black",
          true,
          false,
          LETTER_HEIGHT,
          0.5.mm,
          0,
          true,
          LETTER_DEPTH
        )

        if result
          assign_materials(
            letter.entities,
            amber,
            gold
          )

          bb = letter.bounds

          letter.transform!(
            Geom::Transformation.translation(
              Geom::Vector3d.new(
                cursor - bb.min.x,
                -bb.min.y,
                -bb.min.z
              )
            )
          )

          # Add luminous dots around each letter.
          bb = letter.bounds
          z = bb.max.z + 1.mm

          # Top and bottom rows
          px = bb.min.x + LED_SPACING

          while px < bb.max.x - LED_SPACING
            dot_group = root.entities.add_group
            c = dot_group.entities.add_circle(
              [px, bb.min.y, z],
              Z_AXIS,
              LED_RADIUS,
              12
            )

            f = dot_group.entities.add_face(c)
            if f
              f.material = led
              f.back_material = led
            end

            px += LED_SPACING
          end

          cursor += bb.width + LETTER_GAP
        end
      end

      # Remove the accidental empty group if present.
      model.active_entities.each do |entity|
        if entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Group) &&
           entity.entities.empty? &&
           entity != root
          entity.erase!
        end
      end

      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents

      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da tao mo hinh DEL 3D!\n" \
        "Chieu cao chu: 500 mm\n" \
        "Do day: 100 mm\n" \
        "Vat lieu: Gold + Amber LED"
      )

    rescue => e
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox(
        "Loi tao mo hinh:\n#{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.first}"
      )
    end
  end
end

# ============================================================
# 3D GOLD LED CHANNEL LETTERS - DEL
# SketchUp Ruby API
# Units: mm
# Features:
# - 3D extruded lettering
# - Mirror gold sidewalls
# - Amber illuminated front faces
# - LED-like perforation details
# - Individual groups for each letter
# ============================================================

module GoldLEDLetters
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "DEL_GOLD_LED_3D"

  # Dimensions (mm)
  LETTER_HEIGHT = 500.mm
  LETTER_DEPTH  = 100.mm
  SIDE_THICKNESS = 2.mm
  BORDER_WIDTH = 12.mm
  LED_RADIUS = 5.mm
  LED_SPACING = 25.mm
  LETTER_GAP = 35.mm

  def material(model, name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mat = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)
    entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)

      entity.material =
        entity.normal.z > 0.8 ? front_mat : gold_mat

      entity.back_material = gold_mat
    end
  end

  def add_led_dot(entities, center, radius, mat)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      Z_AXIS,
      radius,
      12
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return unless face

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
  end

  def create_letter(model, character, x_position,
                    front_mat, gold_mat, led_mat)

    group = model.active_entities.add_group
    group.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

    entities = group.entities

    # Create extruded 3D text
    success = entities.add_3d_text(
      character,
      TextAlignCenter = 1,
      "Arial Black",
      true,
      false,
      LETTER_HEIGHT,
      0.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      LETTER_DEPTH
    )

    unless success
      group.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Apply gold and amber materials
    assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)

    # Bounding box
    bounds = group.bounds
    min_x = bounds.min.x
    min_y = bounds.min.y
    min_z = bounds.min.z

    # Place the letter on the baseline
    group.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          x_position - min_x,
          -min_y,
          -min_z
        )
      )
    )

    # LED detail along the front perimeter approximation
    # The dots are placed around the outer bounding box.
    bounds = group.bounds
    z_front = bounds.max.z + 1.mm

    x0 = bounds.min.x
    x1 = bounds.max.x
    y0 = bounds.min.y
    y1 = bounds.max.y

    # Top and bottom rows
    x = x0 + LED_SPACING
    while x < x1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y0, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y1, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      x += LED_SPACING
    end

    # Left and right rows
    y = y0 + LED_SPACING
    while y < y1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x0, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x1, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      y += LED_SPACING
    end

    group
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation(
      "Create Gold LED 3D Letters",
      true
    )

    begin
      # Materials
      gold = material(
        model,
        "Gold_Mirror",
        [184, 134, 45]
      )

      amber = material(
        model,
        "Amber_Illuminated_Face",
        [255, 166, 20]
      )

      led = material(
        model,
        "Warm_White_LED",
        [255, 230, 130]
      )

      # Root group
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME

      # Temporarily make root active for creating children
      model.active_entities.add_group

      # Build individual characters
      cursor = 0.0
      letters = ["D", "E", "L"]

      letters.each do |character|
        letter = root.entities.add_group
        letter.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

        result = letter.entities.add_3d_text(
          character,
          1,
          "Arial Black",
          true,
          false,
          LETTER_HEIGHT,
          0.5.mm,
          0,
          true,
          LETTER_DEPTH
        )

        if result
          assign_materials(
            letter.entities,
            amber,
            gold
          )

          bb = letter.bounds

          letter.transform!(
            Geom::Transformation.translation(
              Geom::Vector3d.new(
                cursor - bb.min.x,
                -bb.min.y,
                -bb.min.z
              )
            )
          )

          # Add luminous dots around each letter.
          bb = letter.bounds
          z = bb.max.z + 1.mm

          # Top and bottom rows
          px = bb.min.x + LED_SPACING

          while px < bb.max.x - LED_SPACING
            dot_group = root.entities.add_group
            c = dot_group.entities.add_circle(
              [px, bb.min.y, z],
              Z_AXIS,
              LED_RADIUS,
              12
            )

            f = dot_group.entities.add_face(c)
            if f
              f.material = led
              f.back_material = led
            end

            px += LED_SPACING
          end

          cursor += bb.width + LETTER_GAP
        end
      end

      # Remove the accidental empty group if present.
      model.active_entities.each do |entity|
        if entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Group) &&
           entity.entities.empty? &&
           entity != root
          entity.erase!
        end
      end

      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents

      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da tao mo hinh DEL 3D!\n" \
        "Chieu cao chu: 500 mm\n" \
        "Do day: 100 mm\n" \
        "Vat lieu: Gold + Amber LED"
      )

    rescue => e
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox(
        "Loi tao mo hinh:\n#{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.first}"
      )
    end
  end
end

# ============================================================
# SACH JUICE - STAND SIGN 3D
# SketchUp Ruby API | Units: mm
# Run in Window > Ruby Console:
# load 'C:/path/to/sach_juice_3d.rb'
# ============================================================

module SachJuice3D
  extend self

  def mat(model, name, rgb)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def beam(entities, name, p1, p2, width, depth, material)
    a = Geom::Point3d.new(*p1)
    b = Geom::Point3d.new(*p2)
    v = b - a
    return if v.length < 0.01

    z_axis = v.clone
    z_axis.normalize!

    ref = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, 1, 0)
    ref = Geom::Vector3d.new(1, 0, 0) if z_axis.parallel?(ref)

    x_axis = z_axis.cross(ref)
    x_axis.normalize!
    y_axis = z_axis.cross(x_axis)
    y_axis.normalize!

    tr = Geom::Transformation.axes(a, x_axis, y_axis, z_axis)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    pts = [
      [-width / 2.0, -depth / 2.0, 0],
      [ width / 2.0, -depth / 2.0, 0],
      [ width / 2.0,  depth / 2.0, 0],
      [-width / 2.0,  depth / 2.0, 0]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p).transform(tr) }

    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    f.reverse! if f && f.normal.dot(z_axis) < 0
    f.pushpull(v.length) if f
    g.material = material
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = material
      face.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = [
      [x, y, z], [x + sx, y, z],
      [x + sx, y + sy, z], [x, y + sy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }
    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    f.reverse! if f && f.normal.z < 0
    f.pushpull(sz) if f
    g.material = material
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = material
      face.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  def panel(entities, name, points, y, thickness, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = points.map { |x, z| Geom::Point3d.new(x, y, z) }
    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    raise "Khong tao duoc mat #{name}" unless f
    f.reverse! if f.normal.y > 0
    f.pushpull(thickness)
    g.material = material
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = material
      face.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  def run
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Sach Juice Sign 3D', true)

    begin
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = 'SACH JUICE - COMPLETE SIGN'
      e = root.entities

      black  = mat(model, 'SJ Black Steel', [25, 27, 31])
      white  = mat(model, 'SJ White Acrylic', [248, 247, 250])
      pink   = mat(model, 'SJ Juice Pink', [230, 28, 100])
      green  = mat(model, 'SJ Leaf Green', [85, 190, 100])
      yellow = mat(model, 'SJ Fruit Yellow', [250, 202, 28])
      red    = mat(model, 'SJ Red Label', [220, 22, 48])
      blue   = mat(model, 'SJ Blue Accent', [30, 95, 190])

      # 1. BASE: 650 x 500 mm
      box(e, 'Base front rail', 0, 0, 20, 650, 40, 40, black)
      box(e, 'Base rear rail', 0, 460, 20, 650, 40, 40, black)
      box(e, 'Base left rail', 0, 40, 20, 40, 420, 40, black)
      box(e, 'Base right rail', 610, 40, 20, 40, 420, 40, black)
      box(e, 'Base crossbar 1', 120, 40, 20, 40, 420, 40, black)
      box(e, 'Base crossbar 2', 490, 40, 20, 40, 420, 40, black)

      # 2. UPRIGHTS AND BRACING
      box(e, 'Left upright', 160, 205, 60, 40, 40, 1350, black)
      box(e, 'Right upright', 450, 205, 60, 40, 40, 1350, black)

      beam(e, 'Left diagonal brace',
           [180, 220, 150], [290, 220, 1370], 35, 35, black)
      beam(e, 'Right diagonal brace',
           [470, 220, 150], [360, 220, 1370], 35, 35, black)
      beam(e, 'Top support',
           [180, 220, 1370], [470, 220, 1370], 40, 40, black)

      # 3. SIGN BODY: rounded-top silhouette
      outline = [
        [100, 2240], [100, 2500], [120, 2580],
        [165, 2650], [220, 2705], [290, 2730],
        [360, 2705], [415, 2650], [460, 2580],
        [480, 2500], [480, 2240], [445, 2110],
        [405, 1950], [365, 1780], [330, 1620],
        [290, 1530], [250, 1620], [215, 1780],
        [175, 1950], [135, 2110]
      ]

      panel(e, 'Black outer casing', outline, 160, 85, black)
      panel(e, 'White front acrylic', outline, 155, 8, white)

      # 4. GRAPHIC PANELS
      # Main pink juice cup, represented as a separate solid panel
      cup = [
        [195, 2110], [380, 2110], [360, 1810],
        [325, 1690], [250, 1690], [215, 1810]
      ]
      panel(e, 'Pink juice graphic', cup, 142, 4, pink)

      # Decorative leaf shapes
      panel(e, 'Left leaf', [
        [115, 2070], [165, 2140], [190, 2040],
        [160, 1990], [130, 2015]
      ], 136, 4, green)

      panel(e, 'Right leaf', [
        [385, 2070], [435, 2140], [450, 2015],
        [420, 1990], [390, 2040]
      ], 136, 4, green)

      # Red product label
      panel(e, 'Red juice label', [
        [205, 2050], [375, 2050],
        [365, 1970], [215, 1970]
      ], 132, 4, red)

      # Yellow fruit accents
      [[225, 1740], [250, 1715], [350, 1745], [365, 1775]].each_with_index do |p, i|
        cx, cz = p
        points = (0..23).map do |k|
          angle = 2.0 * Math::PI * k / 24
          [cx + 18 * Math.cos(angle), cz + 18 * Math.sin(angle)]
        end
        panel(e, "Fruit accent #{i + 1}", points, 130, 5, yellow)
      end

      # 5. TEXT: editable 3D text entities
      # Exact fonts depend on fonts installed on the computer.
      def add_text(entities, name, string, point, height, material)
        g = entities.add_group
        g.name = name
        text = g.entities.add_3d_text(
          string,
          TextAlignCenter = 1,
          'Arial',
          false,
          true,
          height,
          0.0,
          0.0,
          true,
          1.5
        )
        g.material = material
        g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
          face.material = material
          face.back_material = material
        end
        g.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation(
          Geom::Point3d.new(*point)
        ))
        g
      end

      # Text on front plane: horizontal text uses the X axis.
      add_text(e, 'Brand title', 'Sach Juice',
               [290, 120, 2460], 58, green)
      add_text(e, 'Drink subtitle', 'Nuoc ep Detox',
               [290, 115, 2020], 30, white)

      # 6. FOOT / MOUNTING PLATES
      box(e, 'Left mounting plate', 155, 195, 55, 60, 60, 10, black)
      box(e, 'Right mounting plate', 435, 195, 55, 60, 60, 10, black)

      # 7. CAMERA AND VIEW
      model.active_view.zoom_extents
      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da tao mo hinh Sach Juice 3D.\n" \
        "Kich thuoc va hinh in la mo phong tham khao."
      )
    rescue => err
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox("Loi tao mo hinh: #{err.message}\n#{err.backtrace.first}")
    end
  end
end

require 'sketchup.rb'

module Sign_bang_hieu_xinhan_bat_2_ma
  extend self

  def mat(model, name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m.alpha = alpha
    m
  end

  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = [
      [x - sx/2.0, y - sy/2.0, z - sz/2.0],
      [x + sx/2.0, y - sy/2.0, z - sz/2.0],

    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    if f
      f.pushpull(sz)
      g.material = material
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
        face.material = material
        face.back_material = material
      end
    end
    g
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Build bảng hiệu xinhan bạt 2 mặt có trụ 150 x 150', true)

    mat_gold  = mat(model, "Mat_VangKim", [220, 180, 50])

    box(entities, "Khung_Ket_Cau", 0, 0, 0, 1500.mm, 220.mm, 1500.mm, mat_frame)

    box(entities, "Chu_Noi_3D_Logo", 0, (220/2.0 + 16).mm, (1500 * 0.1).mm, (1500 * 0.65).mm, 20.mm, (1500 * 0.35).mm, mat_logo)

    box(entities, "Vien_Kim_Loai_Nẹp", 0, (220/2.0 + 6).mm, 0, 1500.mm, 6.mm, 1500.mm, mat_gold)

  end
end
